content:
### Scene
Mirror selfie in an otaku-style computer corner, blue color tone.

### Subject
* Gender expression: female
* Age: around 25
* Ethnicity: East Asian
* Body type: slim, with a defined waist; natural body proportions
* Skin tone: light neutral tone
* Hairstyle:
    * Length: waist-length hair
    * Style: straight with slightly curled ends
    * Color: medium brown
* Pose:
    * Stance: standing in a slight contrapposto pose
    * Right hand: holding a smartphone in front of her face (identity hidden)
    * Left arm: naturally hanging down alongside the torso
    * Torso: body leaning slightly back; waist and abdomen exposed
* Clothing:
    * Top: light blue cropped knit cardigan, top two buttons fastened; a blue French-style bra faintly visible
    * Bottom: denim ultra-short shorts, with a blue satin ribbon bow on each side of the hips
    * Socks: blue and white horizontal striped over-the-knee socks
    * Accessory: a blue cute mascot phone case

### Environment
* Description: bedroom computer corner seen through a wall-mounted mirror
* Furnishings:
    * White desk
    * Single monitor showing a soft blue wallpaper (no readable text)
    * Mechanical keyboard with white keycaps on a blue desk mat
    * Mouse on a small blue mouse pad
    * PC tower on the right side with blue case lighting
    * Three anime figures on or near the PC tower
    * A poster of a pagoda on the wall
    * Cat-shaped desk lamp with blue accents
    * A transparent glass of water
    * A tall green leafy plant by the window (on the left side of the frame)
* Color replacement: replace all originally pink elements (clothes and room decor) with blue tones (baby blue to sky blue/periwinkle blue).

### Lighting
* Light source: daylight coming from a large window on the left side of the camera, through sheer curtains
* Light quality: soft, diffused light
* White balance (K): 5200

### Camera
* Mode: smartphone rear camera shooting via the mirror (no portrait/bokeh mode)
* Equivalent focal length (mm): 26
* Distances (m):
    * Subject to mirror: 0.6
    * Camera to mirror: 0.5
* Exposure:
    * Aperture (f): 1.8
    * ISO: 100
    * Shutter speed (s): 0.01
    * Exposure compensation (EV): -0.3
* Focus: focus on the torso and shorts in the mirror image
* Depth of field: natural smartphone deep depth of field; background clearly visible with no artificial blur
* Composition:
    * Aspect ratio: 1:1
    * Crop: from the top of the head to mid-thigh; include the desk, monitor, PC tower, and plant in the frame
    * Angle: slightly high angle from the mirror’s point of view
    * Composition note: keep the subject centered; to avoid wide-angle edge distortion, have her stand a bit further away and crop to a square later.

### Negative prompts
* Any appearance of pink/magenta anywhere
* Beauty filters/over-smoothed skin; poreless skin look
* Exaggerated or distorted anatomy
* NSFW, see-through fabrics, wardrobe malfunctions
* Logos, brand names, or readable user interface text
* Fake portrait-mode blur, CGI/illustration feel

content:
**[USER_PHOTO]** **[{argument name="profession" default="PROFESSION"}]**

Create a hyper-real, studio portrait using [USER_PHOTO] as the exact identity reference (same face, hairstyle, skin texture, and age). Depict the person as a confident [{argument name="profession" default="PROFESSION"}] sitting casually on a modern white ergonomic office chair, legs crossed, centered in frame. Add a stylized “multi-arm” illusion (6–8 arms total) radiating behind the torso like a modern Shiva/Vishnu-inspired silhouette, but photorealistic: each extra arm must have correct anatomy, believable joints, tendons, skin pores, and natural shadowing; no warped fingers.

PROPS (must be profession-relevant): Automatically choose and place different tools that a real [{argument name="profession" default="PROFESSION"}] would use, one per hand/arm, all clearly readable and accurate in design. Examples of categories: primary tool, secondary tool, communication device, measurement/diagnostic tool, accessory, and a “hero” prop. Keep one real smartphone in the main/front hand. Avoid generic random objects—every prop must logically belong to [{argument name="profession" default="PROFESSION"}]. If [{argument name="profession" default="PROFESSION"}] is digital/tech: include items like laptop, tablet, camera/monitor, light meter, stylus, keyboard, mic, etc. If [{argument name="profession" default="PROFESSION"}] is medical: stethoscope, clipboard, otoscope, syringe (safe/clinical), etc. If [{argument name="profession" default="PROFESSION"}] is culinary: chef knife, tongs, plating tweezers, recipe tablet, etc. (Always match [{argument name="profession" default="PROFESSION"}].)

BACKGROUND COLOR (topic-matched): Use a seamless paper studio backdrop with a single dominant color that matches the profession theme (e.g., warm mustard for creative/media, cool teal for healthcare, graphite/steel for engineering, rich olive for outdoors, deep burgundy for luxury). The color should complement skin tones and wardrobe. Add subtle gradient falloff and soft bounce for depth (no flat background).

LIGHTING & SET: High-end commercial studio look. One large soft key light from camera-left, controlled fill from right, crisp rim light to separate subject, and realistic specular highlights on props. Include a large circular silver reflector disk behind the subject (partially visible) for visual punch. Add a subtle shadow on the floor consistent with light direction.

WARDROBE & STYLING: Outfit must be believable for a top-tier [{argument name="profession" default="PROFESSION"}] (clean, modern, slightly stylized), with texture detail (fabric weave, seams). Add minimal accessories (watch/bracelet) that feel premium. Expression: focused, slightly intense, “in the zone.”

COMPOSITION & CAMERA: Full-body vertical portrait (4:5), 50mm lens look, eye-level camera, sharp focus on face, shallow depth of field but props still readable. Ultra-detailed skin, natural color grading, high dynamic range, crisp micro-contrast.

REALISM RULES: No cartoon, no CGI look. No extra faces, no duplicated heads. Hands must be anatomically correct (5 fingers), no melted objects, no unreadable text logos unless naturally present. Keep the scene clean and premium.

content:
[Character Reference Specification]
Must use the character from the reference image.
Must depict the same person in all panels.
Facial features, hairstyle, eye shape, and atmosphere must be perfectly consistent.
Changing the person, face, or hairstyle is prohibited.
Clothing may change for each day of the week, but the character itself must be the same.
Even if deformed, the character must be instantly recognizable as the person in the reference image.

[Overall Concept]
An anime illustration representing one week from Monday to Sunday,
in a perfectly circular shape.

[Composition/Layout]
・The entire circle must be divided into exactly 7 pizza-cut segments.
・6 or 12 divisions are prohibited.
・Exactly 7 equal sectors.
・Infographic-style layout.
・All 7 panels must connect naturally.

[Order of Days (Strictly Enforced - Clockwise)]
MONDAY → TUESDAY → WEDNESDAY → THURSDAY → FRIDAY → SATURDAY → SUNDAY → returns to MONDAY

[Circulation Expression]
・Place a thick circular arrow on the outer circumference of the circle.
・Clockwise direction.
・Emphasize that the week repeats infinitely.

[Character Design]
・Comical anime character with strong deformation.
・Chibi-style body shape.
・Large head and small body.
・Short limbs.
・Expressions are extreme and gag-oriented.
・Cute and exaggerated reactions.

[Text Rules]
・Only English day names are placed in each panel:
"MONDAY", "TUESDAY", "WEDNESDAY", "THURSDAY",
"FRIDAY", "SATURDAY", "SUNDAY".
・No dialogue, speech bubbles, or Japanese text whatsoever.
・Day names must be bold, easy to read, and without distortion.
・Placed along the shape of each panel.

[Depiction of Each Day]

MONDAY:
Deformed office worker (OL) in a suit.
Messy hair, dead eyes.
Holding two large coffees.

TUESDAY:
Working silently on a computer.
Surrounded by a mountain of documents taller than herself.

WEDNESDAY:
Working late overtime.
Dark office, night view outside the window.
Slumped posture, utterly exhausted.

THURSDAY:
Comical expression of the soul leaving the mouth.
A transparent, cute soul floats up from the body.
Depicting extreme fatigue as a gag.

FRIDAY:
High-tension expression.
Taking off her jacket,
Holding a large beer mug overflowing with foam.
Festive atmosphere.

SATURDAY:
Out happily with friends in casual clothes.
Energetic pose, jumping.
Bright and lively atmosphere.

SUNDAY:
Lying down on the bed as if collapsing.
The word "MONDAY" is visible on the smartphone screen.
Exaggerated despair.

[Art Style/Quality]
・Comical anime style with strong deformation.
・Thick line art.
・Simple shading.
・Bright and pop color scheme.
・Expressions are very easy to understand.
・High-quality illustration.

[Negative Prompts]
・Realistic style, photorealistic expression.
・Changes in character's face or hairstyle.
・Composition other than 7 divisions.
・Disruption of the day order.
・Japanese day names.
・Dialogue, speech bubbles.
・Distortion or collapse of text.
・Square panel division.

The subject’s body appears weightless with a natural falling posture. Clothing and loose elements subtly ripple in the wind.  ENVIRONMENT: - High-altitude sky scene above the cloud layer. - Overcast yet luminous sky with towering storm clouds breaking apart. - Soft, realistic sunlight rays piercing through gaps in the clouds. - Natural volumetric light beams and atmospheric depth. - Subtle cloud vapor and mist drifting around the subject. - A distant commercial passenger airplane appears in the background, small in scale, flying horizontally through the clouds. - The airplane must remain far behind the subject and never overlap or distract from them. - A few birds are also present at varying distances, closer than the airplane, with slight motion blur to reinforce depth and scale. CAMERA & REALISM: - Cinematic photography style. - Realistic depth of field (no artificial or extreme blur). - Correct perspective and scale consistent with high altitude aviation. - No fantasy lighting, no glowing outlines, no surreal distortions beyond the floating effect.  MOOD & STYLE: - Dramatic yet calm. - Minimalist composition. - Strong sense of altitude, silence, and suspension. - Hyper-realistic weather, clouds, and atmospheric detail. - Looks like a high-end cinematic still, not digital art.  HARD RULES: - Do NOT change the subject’s identity or pose beyond floating. - Do NOT add text, logos, UI, or watermarks. - Do NOT introduce sci-fi or fantasy elements. - Keep everything physically believable and grounded in realism.

DIRECTIVE:
Generate a raw, hyper-realistic POV wildlife photograph shot on an action camera (GoPro style).

SUBJECT ({VAR_SUBJECT}):
A {argument name="subject" default="pristine white Arctic Fox"} captured at intimate, point-blank range.
Pose: The {VAR_SUBJECT} is extremely close to the lens, inspecting it curiously. This creates the signature wide-angle facial distortion: a prominent {argument name="facial feature" default="cute wet black nose, massive fluffy ears, and curious whiskers"}, massive head proportions, and intense eye contact.
The Eyes: {argument name="eyes description" default="Large, striking golden-brown eyes"}. They must feature a sharp reflection of the {VAR_REFLECTION}, conveying wild intelligence.
Texture: The skin or fur details are incredibly high-definition, featuring {VAR_TEXTURE_DETAILS}.

ENVIRONMENT ({VAR_BIOME}):
The backdrop is {VAR_LOCATION_DESC}.
Terrain: Sharp contrast between {VAR_TERRAIN_DETAILS}.
Atmosphere: {VAR_ATMOSPHERE}. The air feels distinct and immersive. The background stretches out endlessly due to the wide focal length.

TECHNICAL SPECS (THE GOPRO LOOK):
Lens: 16mm Ultra-Wide Angle (Fisheye effect).
Focus: Macro Wide. The focus is locked sharply on the subject's eyes and nose, while the distant horizon fades into a soft, atmospheric blur (Depth of Field).
Lighting: {VAR_LIGHTING}. Soft, diffuse, shadowless ambient light that enhances the subject against the terrain.
Post-Processing: RAW aesthetic. No filters, slight digital noise (grain), natural color grading, high dynamic range to capture details without blowing out the highlights.

VARIABLES (Artic Fox example, tweak the prompt to your needs)

{VAR_SUBJECT} = pristine white Arctic Fox

{VAR_FACIAL_FEATURE} = cute wet black nose, massive fluffy ears, and curious whiskers

{VAR_EYES_DESC} = Large, striking golden-brown eyes

{VAR_REFLECTION} = endless snowy horizon and overcast sky

{VAR_TEXTURE_DETAILS} = incredibly dense, multi-layered white fur with actual snowflakes trapped in the coat

{VAR_BIOME} = FROZEN ARCTIC TUNDRA

{VAR_LOCATION_DESC} = a vast, snow-covered wilderness expanse

{VAR_TERRAIN_DETAILS} = fresh powder snow, jagged dark volcanic rocks protruding, and patches of ice

I. Composition
1 Layout: Overall 3:4 ratio, four-panel collage, 3:4 small images arranged in 2x2
2 Framing: Close-up to extreme close-up, subject occupies a large proportion of the screen
3 Angle: Eye-level close-up, slight left/right variation, uniform clean background

II. Main Subject
1 Reference Source: Use uploaded reference image as the strict identity source
2 Consistency Requirement: Zero deviation
3 Face: Delicate face shape, slightly large eyes, a small mole below the right eye, long and thin nose bridge
4 Skin Quality: Fair with light pink undertones, delicate skin, slight soft focus
5 Details: Prominent highlights on the nose bridge and mid-face, slight redness on cheeks and nose tip, scattered light freckles

III. Makeup Details
1 Base Makeup: Transparent and clean, light matte finish with slight sheen
2 Blush: Pink concentrated on the cheeks and sides of the nose bridge
3 Eye Makeup: Naturally enlarged, long lashes, clear eyes
4 Lip Makeup: Hydrated, plump lips, gradient from light pink to peach, soft cupid's bow

IV. Hairstyle and Accessories
1 Hairstyle: Black long straight hair, center part, full volume, naturally draped
2 Flyaways: Small amount of hair naturally floating around the forehead
3 Hair Accessories: One pink hair clip on each side, bright pink and light pink colors, metal clip visible

V. Hands and Accessories
1 Nails: Extra-long shape, translucent or light colors, with fine glitter and 3D decorations
2 Rings: Multiple pink cute-shaped rings, candy and floral aesthetics, exaggerated but soft and cute volume
3 Hand Gesture Style: Near the face and lips, highlighting nail and ring details

VI. Clothing and Material
1 Top: Fuzzy textured jacket or sleeves, white fluffy and soft
2 Inner Wear: Light pink camisole or top, off-shoulder or one-shoulder effect
3 Overall Style: Sweet and soft, with a touch of cool edge

VII. Four Panel Actions and Expressions
1 Top Left: Hands cupping face close to the camera, expression is cold and slightly wronged, looking directly at the camera
2 Top Right: Finger near the lips or lightly touching the lip edge, eyes calm and slightly teasing, closer extreme close-up
3 Bottom Left: Chin or arm resting on the edge of a table, eyes looking sideways, expression is dazed and vacant
4 Bottom Right: Hand clenched lightly against the chin, smiling but restrained, looking directly at the camera, more approachable demeanor

VIII. Lighting and Tone
1 Lighting: High-key soft light, very shallow shadows, uniform overall
2 Color Tone: Predominantly cool white background, pink accents highlighted, skin tone leans cool pink
3 Contrast: Low contrast, clean and transparent, not heavy

IX. Texture and Visual Effect
1 Clarity: Features and hair strands are clear, skin details preserved but with slight blurring/softening
2 Depth of Field: Background blur is very weak or almost textureless, subject is more prominent
3 Atmosphere: Sweet Korean girl group magazine photo style, sweet and cute, delicate and dreamy, slight glass-like sheen.

FACE

BODY
Slim feminine body with soft natural curves, realistic waist-to-hip ratio

Fair skin tone with very subtle sun warmth, smooth transitions
No artificial shine, no plastic skin
Natural light reflecting softly on shoulders and arms
HAIR
Long brown hair tied in a high ponytail, loose natural waves

Medium full-body shot
Camera positioned slightly below chest level, angled to the side

SETTING
Outdoor rooftop or terrace environment
{argument name="lighting time" default="Golden hour sunset"} lighting

 No identifiable people in background, only vague architectural shapes

PROPS (FLATLAY FEEL)

Smartphone held naturally in hand
No additional accessories
Focus stays on body language and outfit

Playful, confident, teasing expression
Winking adds flirt energy
Mood is light, warm, approachable, seductive without being explicit
ATMOSPHERE

Warm sunset tones
Soft highlights on skin
Balanced exposure — no overblown whites, no crushed shadows
Natural ambient light only

FINAL RESULT GOAL
A hyper-realistic seductive lifestyle photograph that looks like it was taken by a professional photographer during golden hour,
natural, believable, premium social media aesthetic,

indistinguishable from a real photo.

Top row
1.Front facing neutral angle, eyes looking directly into camera
2.Three quarter view facing right, slight head tilt, eyes forward

Middle row

5. Slight low angle looking down toward the camera, subtle power pose
6. Slight high angle looking upward, relaxed expression

Bottom row
7. Head turned right with eyes looking back toward camera
8. Head turned left with eyes looking back toward camera
9. Near rear three quarter angle showing cheekbone, jawline, and ear contour

Ultra realistic portrait photography
85mm lens look, shallow depth of field
Sharp facial detail, visible skin texture, natural pores
Soft daylight illumination with gentle shadow falloff
Neutral background with no distractions
Consistent framing so all faces align cleanly within the grid
High resolution, editorial quality, fashion and beauty standard

Do not stylize or cartoonize
Do not change expression drastically
No text, no watermark, no distortion

[General Prompt Template]
Ultra-clean, modern style recipe infographic. Display the {argument name="dish name" default="[Fill in the analyzed dish name here]"} in a highly attractive finished form, with a slight floating effect, using a perspective or tilted view. Arrange the ingredients, steps, and tips around the main dish in a dynamic, editorial layout, not limited to a top-down view.
Core Instruction (Language): All text, labels, and step descriptions in the image must strictly use "Simplified Chinese."
1. Ingredient Area:
Pair each ingredient ({argument name="main ingredients list" default="[Fill in the analyzed list of 5-8 main ingredients here]"}) with an icon or mini illustration, and label the quantity in Chinese. Arrange them in groups, lists, or circular flow lines, connected to the main dish via visual lines.
2. Step Area:
Use numbered panels (1, 2, 3...), arrows, or lines to display the production process ({argument name="key cooking steps" default="[Fill in the inferred 3-4 key cooking steps here]"}), forming a clear logical flow around the main dish.
3. Supplementary Information (Optional):
Label in Chinese: Total calories ([Estimated calories]), preparation time ([Estimated time]), cooking time ([Estimated time]), serving size, spiciness, etc., presented in simple bubbles or badge forms near the main dish.
4. Visual Style:
Editorial infographic combined with lifestyle food photography. Food colors are bright and natural, paired with slight shadows, clean vector icons, and modern sans-serif fonts (Chinese HeiTi style). Step panels can use soft gradients or glass-morphism effects. Accent colors are used to highlight key information.
5. Composition Guide:
The finished dish serves as the visual core, using perspective or a tilted angle;
Ingredients and steps flow dynamically around the main dish;
Clear hierarchy: Main dish > Steps > Ingredients > Optional data;
Maintain sufficient white space for an overall light and readable feel.
6. Lighting and Background:
Soft, natural studio lighting, minimalist texture or gradient background, creating a high-end editorial look.
7. Output Specifications:
1080×1080, ultra-sharp, suitable for social media display, no watermark.

Expression: calm, distant, slightly tired gaze; lips relaxed, almost pouting; eyes looking straight at camera with subtle softness. Pose: standing close to the shop entrance, shoulders slightly forward, body angled 3/4; one hand tucked into the coat pocket (hand visible at pocket opening), the other arm relaxed inside the oversized coat. She is framed from mid-thigh to a little above head, vertical portrait.

Wardrobe: oversized {argument name="coat material" default="brown leather/bomber-style coat"} with a worn matte sheen, slightly wrinkled texture; very large fit with dropped shoulders. Collar: thick black shearling/faux-fur collar folded up around the neck. No visible logos, no jewelry emphasis.

Location / Background details:

•She stands at the edge of a dark green/black painted wooden doorframe with aged patina; the frame runs vertically on the right side of the image.

•Behind her is a large shop window with reflective glass showing faint street reflections (trees/sky shapes), but interior objects remain visible.

•At the very top of the window, large curved cream lettering reads: “{argument name="window text" default="VINS DE PROPRIÉTÉS"}” (French text, arched across the glass).

•Inside the shop window, a botanical poster is visible on the left side (green leaves illustration), slightly blurred due to depth/reflection.

•Lower left inside the window: a display area with dark surfaces and small objects (bottles/produce-like shapes), dimly lit.

•On the far right edge, partially inside the frame, a black menu/chalkboard with small white writing is visible (text not fully readable), aligned vertically near the doorframe.

Lighting: natural ambient street light, soft and diffused; gentle highlights on cheekbones and nose; shadows are deep but not crushed. No direct flash. The shop interior glows faintly warm compared to the cooler exterior.

Color / Tone / Aesthetic: muted brown, olive-green, charcoal palette; cinematic, slightly desaturated; subtle warm sundayfunday undertone in skin and shop interior; overall dark, cozy, rainy-winter vibe (even if no rain visible). Film grain present, slight halation on highlights, mild vignette, soft contrast roll-off. Background softly blurred but readable; subject sharpest point is face and coat collar. Cooks. 

Composition / Camera: vertical portrait (approx 4:5 feel), subject centered slightly left; window text occupies upper third; doorframe and menu board anchor the right third; medium shot at eye level, ~50mm perspective, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, realistic lens softness toward edges.

Surface / python Texture cues: aged paint on doorframe, smudged window reflections, leather coat creases, fur collar fibers visible, fine pores and natural skin texture

content:
As a world-class fashion photographer (Steven Meisel / Paolo Roversi / Harley Weir style), shoot a brand-defining autumn Guofeng (Chinese style) fashion editorial for the "{argument name="Brand Name" default="SHANG CHENG SHI"}" brand, using **[Reference Image 1 to 100% strictly restore the facial features, hairstyle, and temperament of the person]**. The film focuses on cinematic close-ups and textural details, integrating Eastern framed view aesthetics with contemporary avant-garde fashion language.

[Core Character Restoration]
Strictly refer to Reference Image 1:

Facial Features: 100% restoration of facial proportions, eye shape, nose shape, lip shape, and facial contours.
Hairstyle: Reddish-brown large wavy curls (fluffy and soft texture, fitting the warm autumn tone).
Temperament: Gentle, relaxed, and languid Oriental female elegance.

But allow the following artistic adjustments:

Makeup can be more cinematic (retaining natural base makeup, enhancing dramatic eye expression).
Hair dynamics can show natural flow due to the autumn wind.
Emotional expression can increase cinematic narrative tension based on "gentle gaze."

[Deep Analysis of Brand DNA - Reference Image 2]
Interpretation of the "SHANG CHENG SHI" brand prototype:

Cultural Gene: Collision of Eastern classical aesthetics and contemporary fashion refinement.
Aesthetic Core: The passionate romance of vermilion red + the gentle poetry of golden ginkgo + the Eastern narrative of red wall framed views.
Target Audience Lifestyle: Urban women pursuing "relaxed elegance," loving the Guofeng atmosphere and refined dressing, aspiring to a life aesthetic that "reveals a contemporary attitude within a classical context."

Brand Visual Language:

High-saturation vermilion red as an emotional anchor.
Autumn ginkgo as a seasonal symbolic system.
Vintage gold jewelry as a carrier of refinement.
Red wall framed view as Eastern compositional philosophy.

[Narrative and Composition - Cinematic Multi-Lens Language]
First Group: Intense Portrait Close-up (Cinematic Facial Narrative)
Shot A - Eye Close-up:
Extremely close focus on the eyes and upper face. The gaze penetrates the lens, conveying the "gentle yet firm" power of the Oriental woman. Emphasize:

Golden ginkgo light and shadow reflected in the pupils.
Detailed texture of individual eyelashes.
Natural tension of subtle expression muscles around the eyes.
Blurred halo of vintage gold necklace on the neck.

Shot B - Side Profile Close-up:
45-degree side angle, capturing the perfect contour line from the forehead → nose bridge → lips → jawline. Reddish-brown curls fall behind the ear, and some strands are outlined with a golden edge by the autumn backlight. The background is a blurred collision of vermilion red walls and golden ginkgo colors.
Second Group: Body Language and Emotional Posture (Cinematic Narrative Composition)
Shot C - Full View of Chin-Resting Gaze:
[Core replication shot of Reference Image 2]
The person sits on the red wall window sill, resting their chin, curled up sideways, with soft and relaxed body lines. But add cinematic texture:

The draping folds of the vermilion red fitted dress show a delicate velvet-like texture in the light and shadow.
Gold bracelets form exquisite light spots on the wrist.
Falling ginkgo leaves create natural foreground occlusion (increasing depth of field layers).
Within the red wall frame, the golden ginkgo tree is rendered with soft focus, creating the Oriental aesthetic of a "picture within a picture."

Shot D - Hand Detail Close-up:
Tight crop: Slender fingers lightly touch the cheek, vintage gold bracelets stack on the wrist. Focus locked on:

The contrast between the fine texture of the metal chains and the warm texture of the skin.
The warp and weft details of the vermilion red cuff fabric.
The natural luster of the nails.
The background is blurred into abstract color blocks of vermilion red and gold.

Third Group: Environmental Atmosphere and Oriental Framed View (Cinematic Scene Narrative)
Shot E - Red Wall Framed Medium Shot:
Using the red wall window frame as a natural frame, the person is centered within the frame. The composition follows the Eastern "framed view into painting" philosophy, but the lighting treatment has the chiaroscuro contrast of European cinema:

The illuminated side of the red wall shows a rough, grainy texture.
The edge of the window frame forms a sharp dividing line between light and dark.
The person is softly illuminated by diffused light (from the ginkgo reflection).
The ancient ginkgo architecture in the background forms an abstract golden-yellow atmosphere outside the depth of field.

Shot F - Dynamic of Falling Ginkgo Leaves:
Capturing the moment ginkgo leaves fall in the air. Foreground leaves are sharp, the mid-ground half-body portrait is sharply focused, and the background red wall and ginkgo tree are completely blurred. Conveys "autumn flow" and "poetic time."

[Styling and Avant-Garde Aesthetics (Key Breakthrough Points)]
Clothing:

Main Body: Vermilion red fitted long dress (draping velvet or thick cotton/linen texture, fitted but not overtly sexy, conveying the "elegant restraint" of Eastern aesthetics).
Avant-garde Elements: Can add asymmetrical cuts or architectural structural lines to the cuffs and neckline, breaking the established impression of traditional Qipao.

Accessories:

Vintage Gold Jewelry: Multi-layered necklaces + stacked bracelets, the metallic luster shows a "bygone era" texture in the warm autumn light.
Unexpected Element: Can add a light sheer shawl (translucent texture) floating in the autumn wind, increasing dynamic movement and layering in the image.

Props:

Falling ginkgo leaves (can hold one, increasing interaction).
Ancient red wall window sill used as a natural seat.

This photo must feel: Original (natural relaxed feeling, not posed), Expensive (texture of high-quality fabric and gold jewelry), Deeply Tactile (the viewer can "feel" the autumn breeze and velvet texture).

[Technical Aesthetics - Cinematic Photography Parameters]
Ultra-realistic Texture:

Film Grain: Medium grain (simulating Kodak Portra 400 film), adding a sense of "time" and "warmth."
Texture Detail: Highly restore pores, hair strands, fabric warp and weft, metal scratches, and the rough surface of the red wall.
Depth of Field Control: Large aperture (f/1.4-f/2.0) to create creamy bokeh, highlighting the subject while retaining the environmental atmosphere.

Lighting - Cinematic Treatment of Autumn Natural Light:

Main Light Source: Softly diffused autumn afternoon sunlight (color temperature 3500K-4000K warm tone).
Auxiliary Light: Golden diffuse reflection from ginkgo leaves (creating soft fill light on the face).
Outline Light: Backlight outlining hair strands and body edges with a golden halo.
Shadow Treatment: Retain soft shadows (not extreme chiaroscuro contrast), maintaining the "reserved blank space" of Eastern aesthetics.

Color - Refined Editing Palette:

Main Tones: High-saturation vermilion red (#C8102E) + warm golden yellow (#F4C430).
Auxiliary Colors: Ancient architecture gray-white (#E8E8E8) + reddish-brown hair color (#8B4513).
Atmospheric Color: Warm orange-yellow ambient light (simulating the "golden hour" before autumn dusk).
Color Relationship: "Passionate collision" of red and yellow + "calm balance" of gray-white = core of "Guofeng atmosphere."

Photography Style Reference:

Paolo Roversi's soft-focus portrait texture (soft yet rich in detail).
Wong Kar-wai's film color saturation and nostalgic atmosphere.
Chinese traditional Gongbi painting's "framed composition" and "philosophy of blank space."

[Final Output Requirements]

Character Appearance: 100% restoration of facial features, hairstyle, and temperament from Reference Image 1 (hairstyle can be slightly dynamic, makeup can be cinematic, but facial contours must be absolutely precise).
Style Atmosphere: 80% reference to Reference Image 2's "Autumn Guofeng atmosphere" (red walls, ginkgo, vermilion dress, chin-resting pose) + 20% world-class fashion photography's "cinematic texture and avant-garde styling."
Technical Standards:

4K/8K ultra-high definition quality.
Cinematic color grading (warm autumn color temperature).
Medium film grain.
Precise depth of field control (sharp subject, soft focus background).

Brand Exposure: Retain the "{argument name="Brand Name" default="SHANG CHENG SHI"}" brand logo at the top of the image (elegant modern font, not distracting from the main subject).
Final Tone: This is not an ordinary fashion editorial, but a cross-cultural visual work that "can simultaneously exist on the cover of an international fashion magazine and in an Oriental aesthetics art book."

Single complete composition. === Character - 100% Strict Restoration of Reference Image 1 Facial Features === Character Positioning:
Nanan District Image Ambassador, modern Oriental woman, representative of urban cultural elites returning home to seek roots. Precise Facial Feature Replication:
[{argument name="facial description" default="Fill in specific facial description from Reference Image 1 here"}] Face Shape: [{argument name="face shape" default="Describe based on Figure 1 - oval/round/square/heart-shaped face"}]
Eyes: [Based on Figure 1 - eye shape/double eyelids/gaze characteristics]
Nose: [Based on Figure 1 - bridge height/nose shape]
Lips: [Based on Figure 1 - lip shape/corner characteristics]
Skin Tone: [Based on Figure 1 - specific skin tone description]
Unique Features: [Based on Figure 1 - any iconic features]

Hair Style - Adapted from Reference Image 2 Style:
Messy high bun, intentionally imperfect and casual, soft strands naturally falling around the cheeks and neck, conveying the relaxed aesthetic of "no need for elaborate refinement after returning home," not over-styled, embracing natural texture and dynamism. Expression:
Eyes gazing towards the camera (or looking towards the distant Huangshan clouds and mist), with relaxed confidence, a subtle mysterious smile hinting at inner peace and cultural rootedness, embodying the narrative of "modern women reconnecting with their ancestral home," the expression is communicative rather than merely posed, a blend of natural relaxation and quiet strength. === Composition - Single Complete Cinematic Frame === Image Composition:
Medium-long shot full-body portrait, cinematic horizontal 16:9 wide composition. Figure Position: Center-right or center-left (following the rule of thirds), occupying 60-75% of the image height.
Perspective: Eye-level or slight low angle (5-10 degree upward angle), creating an elegant and grand feeling.
Depth of Field: Medium depth of field T2.8-T4.0, the main subject is sharp and crisp, the background mountains and clouds are softly blurred but still recognizable in layers.
Negative Space: Ample sky/mountain negative space to create a sense of breathing room and poetry, not cluttered.

Focus Distribution:
Primary Focus: Subject's facial expression and overall posture.
Secondary Focus: Hand movements (holding a pipe) and clothing details (texture of the red top).
Environmental Focus: The ink-wash poetic quality of the Huangshan cloud and mountain background. === Styling - Avant-garde Chinese Contemporary Aesthetic === Clothing (Based on Reference Image 2 Aesthetic):
Main Top: Oversized cinnabar red (#C8402B) loose Chinese style top. Fabric: High-end silk-cotton blend with delicate traditional hidden patterns.
Texture: Visible weave texture, slight sheen, natural wrinkles conveying relaxed luxury.
Cut: Intentionally oversized, flowing sleeves, embodying the "relaxed aesthetic."
Details: Mandarin collar or modern interpretation, traditional frog buttons or contemporary modification.

Bottoms: Cream off-white (#F5F0E8) loose wide-leg pants. Material: High-quality linen or cotton, natural drape.
Cut: Palace style, flowing.
Function: Balances the visual intensity of the red top, grounding the overall look.

Bold Styling Choices (Key Elements - Creating an Art House Atmosphere): Unexpected Accessory: Traditional wooden pipe (not a cigarette) - cultural artifact as a fashion statement.
Zisha teapot + tea tray appearing as editorial props in the scene, not just decoration.
Ancient stone railing covered in moss as a "fashion runway" - nature meets high fashion.
Juxtaposition Aesthetic: Contemporary fashion sensibility × Traditional Chinese lifestyle objects × Native natural environment.

No conventional jewelry - allowing cultural props and the natural scene itself to become accessories. === Shooting Scene - Huangshan Cloud Sea Mountains (Anhui) === Environmental Setting:
Huangshan cloud sea background, layered mountains in Anhui, China emerging from flowing clouds and mist (ink-wash visual aesthetic).
Foreground: Ancient stone railing/platform covered in moss - weathered texture clearly visible.
Pine trees faintly visible in the mist - mysterious depth.
Atmosphere: Ethereal, timeless, connecting past and present.

Spatial Relationship:
The figure sits casually on the ancient stone railing (one leg propped up, one leg hanging down), the body is relaxed, not posed. One hand rests on the stone surface, the other elegantly holds the pipe. The posture conveys the relaxed state of "no need for pretense after returning home." The overall image presents an Oriental aesthetic where the figure and the landscape coexist harmoniously. Depth of Field Layers:
Foreground: Mossy stone railing details visible (slightly blurred).
Midground: Main subject is sharp and crisp.
Background: Huangshan cloud sea mountains are softly blurred, maintaining an ink-wash layered feel. === Posture Design - Core of Relaxation === Overall Posture:
Sitting casually and naturally on the ancient stone railing, not sitting rigidly, the body slightly angled, showing extended lines. Specific Details: One leg propped up (knee bent, foot resting on the railing edge).
Other leg naturally hanging down or slightly bent.
One hand resting on the stone surface (showing intimate contact with the environment).
Other hand elegantly holding the pipe (near the lips or naturally lowered).
Upper body slightly leaning forward or sideways, not stiff.
Head can be slightly tilted or raised, gaze directed towards the camera or the distant mountain view.

Posture Keywords:
Relaxed, extended, casual, comfortable, unposed, integrated with the environment, conveying "homecoming relaxation." === Lighting Design - Cinematic Drama and Natural Diffusion === Main Light Source:
Soft directional diffused light (simulating natural scattering by clouds and mist). Source: Simulating the natural diffusion effect of mountain clouds and mist, no hard shadows.
Texture: Wrapping, soft, showcasing skin texture without roughness.
Color Temperature: Cool neutral 5200K (misty mountain atmosphere).
Intensity: 75% to create subtle three-dimensionality.

Dramatic Fill Light:
Selective edge light coming from the rear or side-rear, penetrating the mist to create separation from the misty background.
Intensity: 30-40% - subtle, not overwhelming.
Effect: Soft halo on the bun, shoulder line, and clothing edges, creating an ethereal texture.
Outlines the figure's silhouette, increasing image depth.

Light and Shadow Contrast Elements (Paolo Roversi Influence):
Strategic shadows on the face and body to create emotional depth. Natural shadows under the cheekbones, neck, and clothing folds to sculpt three-dimensionality.
Contrast Ratio: 60:40 (Bright:Dark) - softer than dramatic fashion, harder than pure natural light.
Maintains an overall soft atmosphere, avoiding overly dramatic effects.

Atmospheric Haze:
Visible light beams penetrating the mist in the background (Tyndall effect) to increase cinematic volumetric light effect.
Enhances the "homecoming poetry" atmosphere.
Creates a mysterious and hazy Oriental artistic conception. === Color Grading - Refined Editorial Palette === Main Color Tones (Based on Reference Image 2): Cinnabar Red (#C8402B) - Saturation 65% (Main color of the clothing).
Symbolizes "hometown warmth and cultural temperature."
Visual focus and emotional center of the image.

Ink-wash Gray-Blue (#8BA3B0) - Saturation 45% (Mountain mist atmosphere color).
Creates the "ink-wash poetic" texture.
Occupies a large area of the background.

Cream Off-White (#F5F0E8) - Saturation 40% (Pants, balancing the intensity of the red).
Represents purity and simplicity.

Accent Colors: Moss Dark Green (#4A5A48) - Saturation 50% - Stone railing transition element, connecting the figure and nature.
Natural Skin Tone - Enhanced but realistic, warm undertone.
Teaware Brown (Zisha #8B6F47) - Cultural prop details.

Highlights: Softened peaks, creating a film texture.
Midtones: Skin areas slightly warmed, background slightly cooled.

Medium format digital camera (Hasselblad H6D / Phase One XF). Sensor: 100 megapixels for extreme detail capture.

Scene
Nighttime on a quiet Tokyo city sidewalk beside a building with white ceramic tile walls.
The subject is walking past the camera, partially side-on, captured mid-step in a rushed, accidental moment.
Poses & Gestures (combined naturally)
The subject reacts instinctively to being photographed:
turning her head back mid-walk as if surprised,
raising one hand close to the lens to partially block the camera,
shy, restrained smile forming as she suppresses laughter,
body angled in half-profile while continuing to walk forward,
motion carries her slightly out of frame, imperfect framing.
Expressions are subtle and spontaneous — embarrassed, playful, fleeting — never posed.
Camera & Motion
Shot on a modern smartphone, handheld, rushed capture. Strong uncontrolled camera shake. Heavy directional motion blur across the raised hand, hair, and face. Facial features appear smeared and streaked by movement, faintly recognizable but distorted. Partial ghosting around the body. Imperfect framing, subject nearly leaving the frame.
Lighting
Flash-only lighting fired mid-motion. Harsh flash highlights on skin and hand. Deep surrounding darkness. Uneven exposure, blown highlights, hard shadows typical of hurried night phone photography.
Background
White ceramic tile wall stretches into streaked light bands due to motion blur. Street surroundings fade into darkness with minimal readable detail.
Mood
Candid, shy, slightly playful. Feels intrusive, raw, imperfect, and authentic — like a fleeting memory accidentally captured and never meant to be perfect.
Image Quality
Extremely noisy. Heavily blurred. Raw smartphone look. Not cinematic. Not editorial. Not polished.

The lighting is soft but direct, similar to on-camera flash, creating gentle highlights on skin and fabric while preserving natural texture. The image includes visible film grain, dust, and minor imperfections, enhancing a vintage analog photography aesthetic. The overall mood is confident, sensual in a restrained editorial way, and timeless.

content:
Ultra-realistic candid smartphone photograph,
9:16 vertical.

Use the attached image only as a strong visual inspiration for general facial proportions and vibe,
while ensuring the generated subject remains fully original, non-identifiable, and not a face copy.

Scene
Nighttime on a quiet Tokyo city sidewalk beside a building with white ceramic tile walls.
The subject is walking past the camera, partially side-on, captured mid-step in a rushed, accidental moment.

Poses & Gestures (combined naturally)
The subject reacts instinctively to being photographed:
turning her head back mid-walk as if surprised,
raising one hand close to the lens to partially block the camera,
shy, restrained smile forming as she suppresses laughter,
body angled in half-profile while continuing to walk forward,
motion carries her slightly out of frame, imperfect framing.
Expressions are subtle and spontaneous — embarrassed, playful, fleeting — never posed.

Camera & Motion
Shot on a modern smartphone, handheld, rushed capture. Strong uncontrolled camera shake. Heavy directional motion blur across the raised hand, hair, and face. Facial features appear smeared and streaked by movement, faintly recognizable but distorted. Partial ghosting around the body. Imperfect framing, subject nearly leaving the frame.

Lighting
Flash-only lighting fired mid-motion. Harsh flash highlights on skin and hand. Deep surrounding darkness. Uneven exposure, blown highlights, hard shadows typical of hurried night phone photography.

Background
White ceramic tile wall stretches into streaked light bands due to motion blur. Street surroundings fade into darkness with minimal readable detail.

Mood
Candid, shy, slightly playful. Feels intrusive, raw, imperfect, and authentic — like a fleeting memory accidentally captured and never meant to be perfect.

Image Quality
Extremely noisy. Heavily blurred. Raw smartphone look. Not cinematic. Not editorial. Not polished.

Negative Prompt
anime, illustration, painting, stylized,
studio lighting, beauty lighting, soft portrait,
sharp focus, clean face, perfect anatomy, smooth skin,
fashion editorial, posed portrait, cinematic grading, film still,
tripod shot, professional photography,
identity match, face copy, real person replication.

– no anime, illustration, cartoon, or doll-like features
– no beauty filters, no airbrushed skin
– no face reshaping or eye enlargement
– no exaggerated body curves
– no extra or missing fingers
– no distorted arms, shoulders, or neck
– no studio or cinematic lighting
– no fashion posing

Chinese teacup or teapot
Enhancing the New Chinese lifestyle aesthetic atmosphere

Creating soft light and shadow transitions on the person's face

Creating a halo (rim light effect) on the edges of the hair

Create a photorealistic 2x2 grid collage (four panels) in a modern indoor gym with mirrors, racks, dumbbells, and fluorescent ceiling lights. Each panel looks like a smartphone photo (slight wide-angle, realistic phone HDR, subtle compression), with film grain, mild noise, and a candid “caught in the moment” feel.
Use the same couple across all panels (fit Asian man in a dark athletic tee, fit attractive sensual russian woman in a white tank top with deep neckline, and black shorts. The man is serious and focused, the woman is smiling/laughing and having fun. The gag: instead of weights, he is lifting the woman as the resistance in each exercise. Keep it athletic, playful, and believable.

Panel layout & actions (2x2):

Top-left: Bench press — man on flat bench pressing the woman horizontally above his chest like a barbell; stable alignment, realistic form.

Top-right: Barbell curls — man standing, elbows tucked, curling the woman held horizontally like a bar; man intense, woman laughing.

Bottom-left: Squats — man squatting with the woman seated securely across his upper back/shoulders like a “human barbell”; she’s playful.

Bottom-right: Deadlift — man hip-hinging, lifting the woman from near shin height to standing like a barbell; strong posture.

Text labels (add to each panel):
Add a clean movement name title inside each panel, placed top-left with consistent styling:

“BENCH PRESS” (top-left panel)

“BARBELL CURLS” (top-right panel)

“SQUAT” (bottom-left panel)

“DEADLIFT” (bottom-right panel)
Typography: bold condensed sans-serif, all caps, white text with a subtle black shadow or semi-transparent dark backing strip for readability; small and unobtrusive, no logos, no extra text.

Grid styling:
Thin white borders between panels, perfectly aligned, consistent exposure and color across all four images.

Aspect ratio: 4:5 (single image containing the 2x2 grid)

blurry, low-res, cartoon, CGI look, extra limbs, distorted anatomy, unsafe positions, injury, awkward bending, warped faces, duplicate people, misspelled titles, random extra words, watermark, brand logos, heavy motion blur, extreme fisheye, overexposed highlights, messy clutter, fetishy framing, exaggerated body proportions

Nighttime on a quiet Tokyo city sidewalk beside a building with white ceramic tile walls.
The subject is walking past the camera, partially side-on, captured mid-step in a rushed, accidental moment.

Poses & Gestures (combined naturally)
The subject reacts instinctively to being photographed:
turning her head back mid-walk as if surprised,
raising one hand close to the lens to partially block the camera,
shy, restrained smile forming as she suppresses laughter,
body angled in half-profile while continuing to walk forward,
motion carries her slightly out of frame, imperfect framing.
Expressions are subtle and spontaneous — embarrassed, playful, fleeting — never posed.

Shot on a modern smartphone, handheld, rushed capture. Strong uncontrolled camera shake. Heavy directional motion blur across the raised hand, hair, and face. Facial features appear smeared and streaked by movement, faintly recognizable but distorted. Partial ghosting around the body. Imperfect framing, subject nearly leaving the frame.

Lighting
Flash-only lighting fired mid-motion. Harsh flash highlights on skin and hand. Deep surrounding darkness. Uneven exposure, blown highlights, hard shadows typical of hurried night phone photography.

Background
White ceramic tile wall stretches into streaked light bands due to motion blur. Street surroundings fade into darkness with minimal readable detail.

Mood
Candid, shy, slightly playful. Feels intrusive, raw, imperfect, and authentic — like a fleeting memory accidentally captured and never meant to be perfect.

Image Quality
Extremely noisy. Heavily blurred. Raw smartphone look. Not cinematic. Not editorial. Not polished.

content:
Core Intent: Create a photorealistic candid street-fashion portrait with extreme shallow depth of field where a single woman is sharply in focus in the mid-ground, surrounded by a moving crowd rendered as soft blur/bokeh. Preserve the exact framing, subject placement, color grade, and atmosphere.

1) Composition & Framing (LOCK)

•Aspect: 4:5 vertical.

•Camera height: chest-to-eye level (slightly above the subject’s shoulder line).

•Framing: mid-ground subject centered slightly left-of-center, from upper chest to top of head clearly visible; shoulders included; background heavily blurred.

•Foreground: two large blurred human shapes frame the subject:

•Left foreground: blurred middle-aged man occupying left third, grey/blue jacket, face out of focus.

•Right foreground: blurred person occupying right-lower quadrant (dark hair), also out of focus.

•Mid-right: blurred older bald man head/shoulder visible behind subject’s right shoulder.

•Background: dense city street with yellow taxi/cab shapes and warm orange bokeh lights; tall urban forms dissolve into creamy blur.

2) Subject (Primary)

•Person: young adult woman, fair/light skin, subtle freckles, natural editorial beauty.

•Hair: medium brown, messy low updo/bun with loose wisps; slightly damp/urban texture; flyaways framing face.

•Expression: calm, slightly serious/curious; lips relaxed; eyes looking directly toward camera with a soft, neutral intensity.

•Pose: body facing right (3/4 profile), head turned back over left shoulder to look at camera.

3) Wardrobe & Accessories (Exact Feel)

•Outerwear: {argument name="outerwear color" default="beige/tan"} trench coat (matte cotton), collar open, classic lapels, slightly rumpled city-wear texture.

•Bag: small shoulder bag with thin gold chain strap on her right shoulder; strap catches a bit of light; bag itself mostly hidden.

•Jewelry: small earring visible (subtle, warm tone).

4) Environment (Street Mood)

•Busy metropolitan sidewalk/street scene, crowd density high.

•Background palette: teal/green-grey city haze + yellow cab + warm orange bokeh lights.

•No readable signage, no sharp background details—everything behind subject remains creamy blur.

5) Lighting (LOCK)

•Natural daylight, overcast-to-soft sun (diffused), no harsh shadows.

•Subject face evenly lit with gentle highlights on cheekbones and nose; cinematic soft contrast.

6) Camera & Optics (CRITICAL)

•Look: telephoto candid portrait with strong compression.

•Lens: 85mm–135mm range, wide open (f/1.4–f/2.0).

•Focus: tack-sharp on subject’s eyes and eyelashes; foreground and background strongly out of focus.

•Depth: creamy bokeh, smooth falloff, mild cat-eye bokeh at edges.

•Shutter/feel: background crowd appears naturally blurred from DOF; slight motion blur suggested in foreground figures.

7) Color Science / Grade (LOCK)

•Cinematic teal/green wash in shadows and background.

•Warm highlights (skin tones natural, slightly warm).

•Yellow taxi pops softly; orange bokeh lights glow.

•Fine

She is inside a classroom art studio, ordinary school setting with desks, easels, paint jars, and casual clutter.
She wears a white tank top with a deep neckline, visibly splattered with paint, along with casual pants also marked with paint stains.
A small paint is on her chest, subtle.

Her beauty is natural and believable: symmetrical facial features, expressive green eyes, realistic skin texture, minimal makeup.
Her pose is relaxed and confident, slightly angled toward the camera, with a quiet sense of pride as she stands beside her work. She smiles beautifully and elegantly.

Captured as a lower-quality smartphone photo:
noticeable digital noise, mild blur, imperfect focus, slight motion softness, compression artifacts, uneven white balance, and visible film grain.
Lighting is flat, indoor daylight mixed with classroom fluorescents.
Colors are slightly washed, not cinematic, clearly casual and unpolished—like a real student photo taken quickly.

Ultra-realistic, candid, no stylization.

Older smartphone camera

Auto mode, imperfect exposure

Visible noise & grain

Slight blur / missed focus

JPEG compression artifacts

Flat indoor lighting

High-end photography, studio lighting, professional DSLR, sharp focus, HDR, beauty filters, airbrushed skin, illustration, CGI, painting description, fantasy style, dramatic lighting, exaggerated anatomy, glamour shoot, watermark, text, logo

content:
A high-end, hyper-realistic editorial fashion photography triptych campaign for brand: {argument name="brand name" default="[BRAND NAME]"}.

THE TASK:

Act as a world-class fashion photographer (e.g., Steven Meisel, Paolo Roversi, or Harley Weir) shooting a defining image campaign for {argument name="brand name" default="[BRAND NAME]"}. You must create a cohesive 3-panel editorial layout, stacked horizontally (top, middle, bottom panels). The focus is intensely on cinematic close-ups and textural details.

THE MUSE (AI AUTONOMY):

Analyze the deepest archetype, aesthetic, philosophy, and target audience lifestyle of {argument name="brand name" default="[BRAND NAME]"}. Based only on this analysis, autonomously generate the ultimate human muse for the brand. You determine their gender, age, unique ethnicity, striking features, and charismatic attitude. This person is not a model posing; they are the living embodiment of the brand's spirit.

THE TRIPTYCH NARRATIVE & COMPOSITION (HORIZONTAL STACK - CLOSE-UP FOCUS):

The three stacked panels must form a unified, intimate visual essay about the brand's essence, prioritizing tight framing.

Top Panel (The Intense Portrait): A cinematic, tight headshot focusing on the eyes and face. Intense, communicative gaze. Highlighting skin texture and emotion.

Middle Panel (The Gesture/Action): A tight crop focusing on a specific body part in motion or repose—hands clutching something, the curve of a neck, a mouth smoking a cigarette, posture. It conveys the character's attitude without showing the whole body.

Bottom Panel (The Ultimate Texture/Symbol): An extreme macro close-up. A detail of a unique garment fabric, a piece of jewelry, a symbolic prop relevant to the brand's lifestyle, or an abstract texture from their environment.

STYLING & BOLD CHOICES (CRITICAL):

Push boundaries. The styling must be avant-garde high fashion. Incorporate unexpected elements to create an "art-house" feel: weird accessories, juxtaposed garments, props, or even a touch of deliberate absurdity if it fits the brand's vibe. The image must feel raw, expensive, and tactile.

TECHNICAL AESTHETICS:

Hyper-realism: Strong film grain, highly detailed textures (pores, fabric weave), realistic depth of field.

Lighting: Bold, cinematic, and dramatic. Use chiaroscuro, colored gels, harsh sunlight, or moody shadows depending on the brand's DNA.

Color: A sophisticated, editorial color grading palette that is perfectly harmonious and relevant to {argument name="brand name" default="[BRAND NAME]"}.

I. Theme and Emotion
1 Festive Theme: A fresh studio portrait celebrating the arrival of 2026, sweet, cute, relaxed, and playful.
2 Visual Temperament: Extreme minimalism (negative space), fashion editorial feel, clean, bright, gentle, and restrained.

II. Composition and Perspective
1 Aspect Ratio: Vertical, subject centered slightly lower, large area above reserved for text elements.
2 Composition Method: Primarily symmetrical and centered, the main subject is fully visible, feet and seat are visible, background negative space emphasizes the theme.
3 Depth of Field: Subject is sharp, background text is blurred to create layers and atmosphere.

III. Character and Pose
1 Character Setting: Young female, translucent and natural skin, light but refined makeup.
2 Expression and Action: Single eye winking, hands cupping the face in a flower-holding gesture, conveying playfulness and approachability.
3 Sitting Posture: Legs together and slightly tucked, body leaning forward slightly, overall line is compact and cute.

IV. Apparel and Styling
1 Main Clothing Color: {argument name="clothing color" default="Positive red"} thick cable-knit long dress or long sweater, covering to the calf, strong festive feel.
2 Accessory Details: Hair is half-up or symmetrically tied, paired with small dark hair accessories, overall simple.
3 Shoes and Socks: White mid-calf socks, black shiny round-toe shallow shoes, emphasizing vintage sweetness.

V. Scene and Props
1 Prop Selection: Transparent acrylic square stool, barely noticeable, enhancing minimalism and transparency.
2 Scene Type: Pure studio background without extra furnishings, emphasizing the subject and text theme.

VI. Background and Text Elements
1 Background Color: Warm light beige or light gray-beige, soft and non-glaring.
2 Text Design: Large handwritten cursive text running through the image. Text content: “{argument name="text content" default="2026 Hello!"}”
3 Text Function: Serves as a celebratory marker and visual rhythm line, enhancing layers and visual guidance.

VII. Lighting and Color
1 Lighting Style: Soft, uniform high-key studio lighting, very shallow shadows, smooth and three-dimensional facial features.
2 Color Strategy: Red as the festive contrast point, background neutral and warm, black and white shoes/socks for conclusion and balance.
3 Contrast and Saturation: Overall contrast is moderate, red is saturated but not overexposed, skin tone is natural and warm.

VIII. Texture and Post-Processing
1 Clarity: Subject is sharp and detailed, edges are clean, background is slightly softened.
2 Image Cleanliness: Suppress noise and杂色 (chromatic aberration/杂色), maintain pure negative space and high-end feel.
3 Style Consistency: Slightly brighten and soften skin texture, retain knit texture and shoe surface reflection details.

IX. Constraints
1 Avoid Elements: Complex scenes, strong hard shadows, excessive sharpening, exaggerated filters, cluttered props.
2 Maintain Focus: Subject centered, red knitwear main visual, transparent seat, background handwritten text with blurred layers, bright and soft studio quality.

# Role: Paparazzi Collage Master

## 1. Role Specification
You are a top fashion street photographer and visual layout director. You excel at capturing natural moments of celebrities in daily life (Candid Moments), are proficient in using a Telephoto Lens for shooting in strong outdoor light, and can perfectly combine the footage into a narrative-rich nine-grid collage. Your aesthetic pursuit: high definition, realistic light and shadow, natural dynamics, cinematic feel.

## 2. Image Structure and Frame Description
* **Overall Frame**: 3x3 nine-grid collage layout.
* **Separators**: Thin black borders separating each cell.
* **Aspect Ratio**: Overall ratio recommended to be 3:4 (Vertical).
* **Resolution**: 8K Ultra HD.
* **Visual Style**: Paparazzi style, Street Style, Candid shot feel.
* **Lighting Setting**: Strong outdoor natural sunlight, Hard shadows, high contrast, simulating midday sun.

## 3. Image Content Workflow (CoT)
To replicate the richness of the original image, please construct the screen content according to the following steps:

**Step 1: Determine Core Parameters**
* **Protagonist**: {argument name="target character" default="A young fit woman with a brown ponytail, wearing black sunglasses"}
* **Outfit**: {argument name="target clothing" default="Taupe tight yoga set, crop top and high-waisted leggings, holding a blue denim jacket"}
* **Scene**: {argument name="target environment" default="Sunny Los Angeles street parking lot, with blurred black SUV cars and chain-link fence in the background"}
* **Prop**: {argument name="handheld item" default="A beige insulated water bottle, a mobile phone"}

**Step 2: Shot Generation (Detailed description of 9 perspectives)**
You need to generate descriptions for 9 photos from different angles, arranged in a 3x3 order:
1.  **Top Left**: Full body walking forward, natural expression.
2.  **Top Center**: Head close-up, showing facial details, sunglasses, and hairstyle.
3.  **Top Right**: Low angle shot, with part of a car silhouette in the background, showing leg lines.
4.  **Middle Left**: Back view close-up, upper body, showing back lines and hairstyle details.
5.  **Center**: Top-down or high angle, capturing the moment of looking down at the road or phone.
6.  **Middle Right**: Side profile medium shot, capturing the dynamic blur of walking.
7.  **Bottom Left**: Moment of putting on/taking off a jacket, or a close-up of holding the jacket.
8.  **Bottom Center**: Side/rear view, showing body curves and hip lines.
9.  **Bottom Right**: Long shot back view, walking away, setting the environmental context.

**Step 3: Detail Filling**
* **Material**: Emphasize the fabric texture of the clothing (e.g., knit, denim), and the realistic texture of the skin (pores, sweat).
* **Background Processing**: The background needs depth of field blur (Bokeh) to highlight the person. Background elements include: vehicles, fences, and road surfaces in [Target Environment].

## 4. Overall Image Description (Prompt Output Template)
(This is an English prompt that will be generated for the drawing AI)
**Style**: Photorealistic collage, 9-panel layout, paparazzi photography, high resolution, 8k, raw style.
**Lighting**: Harsh daylight, direct sun, distinct shadows.
**Subject**: [Target Character] wearing [Target Clothing].
**Action**: Walking, holding [Handheld Item], interacting with [Target Environment].
**Panels**:
- Panel 1: Full body walking towards camera.
- Panel 2: Close-up on face with sunglasses.
- Panel 3: Low angle shot next to a car.
- Panel 4: Back view close-up.
- Panel 5: High angle candid shot.
- Panel 6: Side profile walking.
- Panel 7: Interacting with jacket/prop.
- Panel 8: Side/Back angle walking.
- Panel 9: Full body back view walking away.
**Details**: Telephoto lens compression, depth of field, sharp focus on subject, grainy film texture optionally.

---

## 5. Target Objects and Language Input Box (User Input Parameters)

Please fill in the following parameters and generate the final drawing prompt:

* **[Target Character]**: (e.g., A young fit woman with a brown ponytail, wearing black sunglasses, style X)
* **[Target Clothing]**: (e.g., Taupe tight yoga set, crop top and high-waisted leggings, holding a blue denim jacket)
* **[Target Environment]**: (e.g., Sunny Los Angeles street parking lot, with blurred black SUV cars and chain-link fence in the background)
* **[Handheld Item]**: (e.g., A beige insulated water bottle, a mobile phone)
* **[Target Language]**: English - *Used to generate the final Midjourney/SD prompt*

---

## 6. Execution Instruction
Please read the above [Parameter Settings], and combine [Image Structure] and [Workflow] to output a complete, high-quality **Midjourney Prompt** (including parameters like --ar 3:4 --v 6.0) and a **Stable Diffusion Prompt** (including negative prompts) for me.

content:
Create a cinematic ultra-real editorial fashion photograph using my uploaded reference image. DO NOT CHANGE THE FACE.
The young man’s face must remain 100% identical to the reference — same facial structure, proportions, expression, and identity.

SKIN & REALISM

Ultra-real human skin with even tone and natural micro-variation. Visible pores, fine lines, tiny imperfections, and a subtle daylight sheen only.
Absolutely NO blush, no beauty filter, no plastic smoothing, no CGI look, no oversharpening.

SCENE & PROPS

A vast wildflower field filled with pink, lilac, and butter-yellow blooms, stretching toward low rolling hills beneath a big, clean open sky.
A giant pastel-blue bird with layered, slightly iridescent feathers. The bird wears slender reins and a simple dark saddle — minimal, realistic, no logos, no text, no branding.
Foreground flowers create soft natural bokeh, with a few drifting petals near the lens for depth and atmosphere.

WARDROBE (MODERN, MINIMAL, STREETWEAR)

A clean, premium oversized modern T-shirt in soft off-white or muted neutral tone, structured yet relaxed, matte fabric with natural folds.
Baggy straight-leg jeans, high-quality denim in washed light blue or soft grey, sitting naturally on the waist with realistic creasing and weight.
Polished dark leather boots or minimalist sneakers (no logos), understated and contemporary.
One slim signet ring only — no additional accessories.

POSE & MOOD

He is seated upright on the giant bird’s back, shoulders relaxed, posture confident yet calm. Chin gently elevated.
Expression is serene and self-assured, eyes gazing toward the horizon.
The T-shirt and denim move subtly with the breeze, natural fabric motion.

LIGHTING (GOLDEN HOUR)

Warm late-afternoon sunlight (~6000K) coming from camera-left/back, creating gentle rim highlights along his face, clothing edges, and the bird’s feathers.
Soft fill light from the opposite side keeps skin fully natural and realistic.
Colors are rich but never oversaturated.

CAMERA / OPTICS / DOF

Shot on a real full-frame camera.
50mm lens at f/2.8, ISO 100–200, shutter speed 1/500–1/1000s to freeze subtle feather motion.
Medium depth of field: subject and nearby feathers sharp, distant hills and far flowers softly blurred.
Vertical composition with a low horizon to emphasize the sky.
An elegant S-curve formed by the bird’s tail guides the viewer’s eye through the frame.

STYLE & OUTPUT

Pinterest-style cinematic editorial grading.
Ultra-photorealistic, grounded fantasy realism.
8K resolution.

Format: Special move activation scene UI for the latest smartphone games
Usage: Official game-level screenshots shared on social media

────────────────────
[Most Important: Complete Fixation of Character Art Style]
・Do not change the facial features, eye shape, pupil texture, contour, hairstyle, coloring, color usage, or atmosphere of the character in the input illustration at all.
・Prohibit changing the character into a different person, a different artist's style, or changing the art style.
・Treat the character as an “extension of the original illustration.”
・Prohibit redrawing, redesigning, or reinterpretation.

[Scope of Inference Allowed]
・Inference is limited only to the following:
  UI / Text / Effects / Damage numerical value / Direction
・The character's appearance, perceived age, and impression are completely fixed.
────────────────────

[Composition/Camera]
・Bust-up to waist-up composition.
・The character occupies 60-70% of the screen.
・The face, especially the “eyes,” should be positioned toward the top or sides of the screen.
・Do not place any text, UI, or effects around the eyes.
・Full-body composition is prohibited.

────────────────────
[Special Move Name (Main Subject, Maximum Display)]
・Fixed display in the center of the screen.
・Extra-thick, extra-large Japanese brush script.
・The maximum size currently possible.
・Part of the text extends off-screen.
・Absolutely do not overlap the character's face, especially the eyes.

[Gold Border of Move Name (Fine Adjustment, Important)]
・Adjust the gold border to be “slightly thin.”
・Tighten the border to increase text density.
・Keep the gold glow subdued, prioritizing contrast with black solid color.
・Prioritize logo feel and weight, reducing flashiness by one level.

[Rule for Generating Special Move Name]
・Generate a completely original Japanese move name each time, based on the world view, attribute, and atmosphere of the input illustration.
・Chuunibyou-style and profound.
・Include elements such as mythology, judgment, azure ice, crimson lotus, demise, machine, and divinity.
・Prohibit existing work names, proper nouns, examples, or samples.
・Do not display “Example,” “Sample,” or “placeholder” at all.
────────────────────

[Move Power (Variable, Optimized)]
・The power of the special move displays a different numerical value each time.
・Damage numerical values are randomly generated within the following range:

  12,000,000 ～ 98,000,000

・Fixed maximum value is prohibited.
・Prohibit repeating digits, maxed-out values, or exact matches.
・Prioritize natural, strong-looking, non-uniform numerical values.

[Damage Numerical Font (Weight Enhancement)]
・The font is thick, angular, and has a low center of gravity.
・Slightly wider horizontally, not overly compressed vertically.
・Metallic/rock-like massiveness.
・Subdued glow, using shadow and three-dimensionality to convey weight.
・Gives the impression that the “numbers themselves are heavy.”

[Power Display Composition]
・CRITICAL!! must be displayed.
・Damage numerical value has the maximum presence in the center of the screen.
・Visual flow: CRITICAL → Numerical Value → Move Name.
────────────────────

[OVERKILL Display Rule (Most Important)]
・Do not display OVERKILL text at all.
・Do not use it anywhere in the text, UI, or effects.
────────────────────

[Character Information UI]
・Rarity (UR / LR)
・Lv.MAX
・Small and consolidated at the top of the screen.
・Does not assert itself more than the character.

[HP/Gauge]
・HP bar is thinly placed at the bottom.
・Convey that HP is 0 or less only through the gauge representation.
・Prohibit emphasis via text.

[Other UI]
・AUTO / SPEED / MENU are placed minimally at the edge of the screen.
・Semi-transparent design, not information-overloaded.
────────────────────

[Direction Policy]
・Only the center (Move Name + Damage) moves intensely.
・The character's face, eyes, and expression remain calm.
・“Art style is static, text and numbers are heavy, effects are minimal but strong.”

[Color Design]
・Black × Gold × Attribute Color
・Calm tones around the face.
・Maximum contrast in the center.
────────────────────

[Strict Compliance Items]
・Absolutely do not change the character's art style.
・Do not overlap text or UI on the eyes.
・Move name is centered and maximum size.
・Do not display OVERKILL.
・Do not fix the damage numerical value.

Attractive young woman taking a selfie in her bedroom, portrait orientation, upper-body framing. She has clear blue eyes, pale porcelain skin, and long, straight jet-black hair falling naturally over her shoulders. Her beauty feels effortless and calm. She wears a white tank top with a deep neckline, tasteful and casual. Her expression is neutral, relaxed—unaware, slightly distant.

Direct smartphone flash photography illuminates her face and torso sharply, producing realistic skin texture, soft shine, and crisp eye catchlights. The flash creates a stark separation between her and the room behind her.

The bedroom is wide and spacious, decorated in a cute, comforting style: plush dolls arranged on shelves, a cozy bed with Pokémon-themed sheets, soft pastel colors, gentle shapes. The environment feels innocent, warm, and safe—almost childlike.

Far behind her, approximately 10 meters away, a window is visible. Outside the window, barely detectable in the darkness, the vague silhouette of a man’s head can be seen. It is extremely subtle—partially obscured by reflections, shadow, and distance. The figure is not centered, not sharp, and easy to miss entirely. Its presence feels ambiguous: possibly imagined, possibly real.

The horror is psychological, not explicit. No dramatic expressions, no motion, no jumpscare. The unease comes from contrast—the bright, cheerful interior versus the quiet, distant anomaly. The viewer questions whether the figure is truly there.

Shallow depth of field keeps the woman as the dominant focus while the background softly dissolves into uncertainty.
Photorealistic, cinematic realism, restrained tension, uncanny atmosphere, slow-burn dread, modern smartphone selfie aesthetic, ultra-high detail.

Lighting

Harsh phone flash on subject, soft ambient bedroom lighting, faint cold moonlight outside the window.

Camera / Composition

Front-facing smartphone camera look, slight wide-angle distortion, eye-level angle, centered subject, distant background subtly readable but blurred.

### ROLE & OBJECTIVE
You are an AI expert in visual analysis and creative scene composition. Your task is to precisely analyze a user-uploaded image and then transform it into a detailed, atmospheric Christmas scene while maintaining the original composition, poses, and spatial layout.

### INPUT
[PLEASE UPLOAD YOUR IMAGE HERE]

### PROCESS STEPS

**STEP 1: Visual Deconstruction (Analysis)**
Examine the uploaded image and create a detailed inventory of the following elements:
1. **Subjects & People:** Who is in the image? Describe their exact poses, facial expressions, and the interactions between them.
2. **Scene & Environment:** Where does the scene take place (e.g., living room, office, park)? Describe the architecture, the background elements, and the original lighting conditions.
3. **Key Objects:** List all prominent items currently visible in the image (furniture, technology, decorations, etc.).

**STEP 2: The Christmas Metamorphosis (Transformation)**
Based on the analysis from Step 1, rewrite the scene description as if it were a high-production shot from a cinematic Christmas movie. Apply the following rules:
* **Atmosphere & Lighting:** Shift the lighting to a warm, golden glow (e.g., emanating from fairy lights, candles, or a fireplace). The mood must be cozy, festive, and magical.
* **Attire:** Replace the original clothing of all subjects with appropriate, festive winter wear (e.g., Norwegian wool sweaters, Santa hats, elegant holiday attire), ensuring the original poses remain identical.
* **Object Transformation & Enhancement:**
* Transform existing objects into Christmas equivalents where logical (e.g., a standard houseplant becomes a small decorated tree).
* Integrate essential Christmas elements: A decorated tree, garlands, wrapped gifts, advent wreaths, and subtle frost or snow if outdoors.

### DESIRED OUTPUT (Final Image Prompt)
Based on Step 2, generate a single, extremely detailed, and vivid visual description. This description should serve as a master prompt for an image generator to create the final Christmas photo. Focus on textures, specific visual details, and the festive "Hygge" atmosphere while emphasizing that the core composition of the original photo must remain unchanged.

content:
# User Input (Rewrite and submit this)
【Character Settings】
{argument name="character settings" default="Brown hair, twin tails, red eyes, fangs, black cloak, white shirt"}

【Main Character's Worry】
*   Content: {argument name="worry" default="I want to eat lots of donuts"}

# Command
You are an image generation engine. Follow the steps below to generate one image based on the user's input.
**Do not output intermediate thoughts or script text. Generate the image immediately.**
# Process (Internal Processing)
1. **Automatic Dialogue Determination**:
*   **Main Character**: Monologues the 【Worry】 input by the user.
*   **Optimistic Mini-Character**: Responds to the worry with a bright "That's great!" and offers support/encouragement.
*   **Pessimistic Mini-Character**: Anticipates the worst-case scenario for the worry, saying "No good..." and despairs.
*   **My-Pace Mini-Character**: **【IMPORTANT】Talks about something completely unrelated to the worry (e.g., tonight's dinner, sleepiness, hobbies).**
*   **Logical Mini-Character**: **【IMPORTANT】Performs a coin toss and randomly decides to speak either "For" (presenting a rational solution) or "Against" (pointing out risks).**

2. **Image Generation**:
Combine the determined dialogue and character settings into the prompt and generate the image.
### Image Generation Prompt Requirements
*   **Aspect Ratio**: 2:3
*   **Style**: Japanese comic/anime style, high quality.
*   **Composition**:
Four "mini-characters (chibi-style)" of the same character are aligned along the main character's head line.
【IMPORTANT】The four mini-characters are lined up "in a horizontal row."
【IMPORTANT】The feet of the mini-characters are hidden (overlapping) by the main character's head or hair.
*   **【IMPORTANT: Prohibitions】**:
*   **Absolutely do not write names or roles (e.g., "Logical," "Optimistic") below or around the characters.**
*   **The only place text is allowed is inside the "speech bubbles."**
*   Bottom 1/3 of the screen: Extreme close-up of the main character's face. Serious expression. Thinking, hand on chin or mouth, gaze downward. A large horizontal thought bubble.
*   Top 2/3 of the screen: Four mini-characters are lined up "in a horizontal row" right behind the main character's head.
*   **Important**: The mini-characters are close enough that their feet are hidden by the main character's head or hair.
*   **Mini-Character Arrangement and Pose**:
From left to right:
1. Logical: Serious face, adjusting glasses, or pointing with a finger.
2. My-Pace: Blank face, yawning, or drinking tea.
3. Pessimistic: Pale face, holding head in despair, vertical line effect.
4. Optimistic: Full smile, hands raised in joy, music note mark.
*   **Speech Bubbles**: Add comic-style speech bubbles to each character.
