content:
# Generate Results for the Celtic Cross Spread
## Fortune-Telling Parameters
- Card indicating the essence of the problem: {argument name="card essence of problem" default="(Fill in 1 card from 78 cards)"}
- Question to be asked: {argument name="question to ask" default="(Describe in one sentence)"}
## Image Requirements
### Canvas Settings
- 2048*2048px 2K image
- Cards and text elements must be at least 20px away from the canvas edges
- The card layer should be placed horizontally centered and in the upper 2/3 vertically
- The text layer (explanation section) should be placed in the lower 1/3 vertically
### Background Layer
- Dark purple background with dark gold stars, clouds, moon, sun, and lines of circles and triangles added to create a mystical atmosphere
### Card Layer
- Use all 78 standard Tarot cards. Breakdown: 22 Major Arcana (from "The Fool" to "The World") and 56 Minor Arcana (4 suits: Wands, Cups, Swords, Pentacles).
- Each Minor Arcana suit includes number cards 1 through 10 and 4 Court cards.
- The edges of the cards are framed with golden metallic vines, and the inside depicts the corresponding image and the name in Japanese. The size of each card is unified and arranged so as not to be cramped. To ensure the text and images of the overlapped cards are visible, the short side (bottom and top edges) of the card should be 1/2 the length of the long side.
- Each extracted card must appear only once. If duplication occurs during random extraction, redraw a different card.
- Exclude the card specified in "Fortune-Telling Parameters - Card indicating the essence of the problem," and extract the spread from the remaining cards.
- Extract 1 card randomly, placed vertically in the center.
- Extract 1 card randomly, placed horizontally in the center (with the top of the card facing left), overlapping the vertical center card to form a cross.
- Extract 1 card randomly for each position (Up, Down, Left, Right) surrounding the central cross.
- Extract 4 cards randomly in a vertical column on the right side.
### Meaning of the Spread
- Center, vertical: Current situation and personality
- Center, horizontal: Obstacles and contradictions
- Up: Hopes and achievements
- Down: Potential and influence
- Left: Past
- Right: Near future
- Right column, 1st card: Wishes and concerns
- Right column, 2nd card: Environment and family
- Right column, 3rd card: Result of the reading
- Right column, 4th card: Final outcome
### Text Layer
- Use Mincho font, dark gold color, with a 2px black border (#000).
- Card Name: Display the name in Japanese at the bottom center of each generated card image. For horizontally placed cards, the name should be displayed at the bottom of the card itself (not the bottom relative to the horizontal placement).
- Explanation Section: Include the following content in the explanation section.
   - On the left side of the explanation section, list all extracted cards in the format: "[Meaning of the Spread] Card Name".
   - On the right side of the explanation section, describe the possible interpretation by connecting the meaning of each card in the spread, based on the "Fortune-Telling Parameters - Question to be asked".
   - Decorate the explanation section with a golden vine pattern border.

content:
Giant Kanas and Hemu
As if the Creator accidentally enabled developer mode
And directly rendered huge 3D coordinates on the snow-capped peaks
It not only understood the skeleton of winter
But also rendered the thin, crisp coldness in the air
Into tangible granularity on the screen.
Staring at it for a long time, the brain truly generates an illusion:
This world is actually a giant cream cake
And these snow-covered spruces
Are the matcha powder and frosting sprinkled on top

The texture of the flowing river doesn't look like water

It looks more like a dream fluid🌊 stacked up by Nanobanana using liquid glass and sea salt jelly, bit by bit

At this moment, I really want to crawl into that small wooden house
And set myself to flight mode

Outside the window is the ultimate pure white of minus 20 degrees
Inside the house is the caramel-flavored warmth of freshly baked heating🔥

If life is too noisy and work stress is too heavy
Why not be a deserter and hide in this painting

In this snow country model, built by Nanobanana and beautiful beyond words
Be an NPC who doesn't have to reply to messages

content:
A trendy café bathroom mirror selfie with chaotic, confident “unhinged but make it fashion” energy. The phone is visible in the mirror, classic selfie POV, camera slightly above eye level. Harsh overhead bathroom lighting that would be unflattering on most people, but she completely owns it. The mirror is slightly dirty with water spots, clearly a real bathroom, not a photoshoot.

A young adult woman taking a mirror selfie with an intentionally unhinged pose. One leg is up on the sink, knee bent, creating a chaotic body line. Alternatively, she’s arched dramatically against the wall next to the mirror, head tilted back. Her upper body is twisted to catch angles, pulling slightly at her top or aggressively playing with her hair. She’s facing the mirror with intense eye contact — pure “I know I’m hot” energy. Lips slightly parted, biting the lower lip or tongue touching the upper lip, one eyebrow subtly raised. Main-character confidence that feels earned.

She has sharp facial features, a defined jawline, full lips, glowing youthful skin with a dewy finish. Slim but curvy in all the right places, tight waist, youthful firmness. Her hair is warm honey blonde, long messy waves, intentional chaos like she’s been running her hands through it all day.

She’s wearing a going-out outfit, clearly stopped in the bathroom to document how good she looks. A tiny cropped tank or going-out top, tight and minimal, {argument name="top color" default="white, black, or red"}, showing stomach with light cleavage. Bottoms are high-rise or low-rise denim shorts, very short, fitted, showing legs and hip line, effortlessly sexy without trying too hard. Shoes are either not visible or chunky platform soles barely peeking into frame.

Accessories include chunky silver hoop earrings, layered silver chains (one with a charm), a tiny purse on the counter or still worn crossbody, and a trendy phone case with bows or rhinestones.

The bathroom is a popular aesthetic café restroom: large mirror, possible stickers or a lipstick kiss mark in the corner, marble or ceramic sink, tiled or color-painted walls, maybe a neon sign or art piece, soap dispenser and paper towels visible. It’s the bathroom everyone takes photos in — she’s just doing it better. Face and hair should closely match the reference image I uploaded — same facial structure, proportions, expression style, and hair color/texture/length. Preserve the identity, facial harmony, and hair details from the reference image without stylization drift.

Smartphone mirror selfie, sharp quality, no flash, framed wide enough to capture the absurd pose. Vertical 9:16 aspect ratio. The overall vibe is reckless confidence, zero self-consciousness, social-media ready — sexy without being explicit, attitude over skin.

GENERAL STYLE & MOOD:
“Epic Figurative Art.” The prompt requires multi-layered analysis of the user’s provided home screen (articles, headings, used apps, notifications, colors) to condense all “elements” of the year into a single still image. It should be a fusion of philosophical, profound realism and surreal design.

TASK & ANALYSIS:
1. Comprehensively scan the text information within the provided home screen to extract frequently used vocabulary, interests, emotional fluctuations, and fragments of daily life.
2. Integrate these “total elements of the year” and select one ultimate “single Kanji character” that symbolizes the user’s journey.
3. Construct the “strokes” of that Kanji character as a three-dimensional collection of concrete events analyzed (e.g., work tools, hobby fragments, motifs from read articles).

SUBJECT:
The “single Kanji character” embodying the user’s year, centrally positioned.
- This character is a “collection of micro-stories.” Upon closer inspection, the parts of the character should be formed by specific objects that colored the user’s year (e.g., designs symbolizing specific news articles, daily tools, fragments of memory).
- Maintain perfect readability of the Kanji and ensure it has a strong skeletal structure.

ENVIRONMENT & BACKGROUND (The Total Year Narrative):
The background should also be depicted not merely as scenery, but as an epic panorama covering “all elements of the year.”
- Background composition: Behind the character, the analyzed events of the year should spread out as scenery, either chronologically or thematically (e.g., symbols of challenged projects, the atmosphere of visited places, images of engrossing news).
- Consistency: The central Kanji should be the core of the “world” of that year, with all background elements converging towards the character or overflowing from it.

LIGHTING & TEXTURE:
- Profound texture that conveys “layers of memory.” Metal, organic matter, light particles, and digital data should mix, possessing physically correct reflections and shadows.
- Background light sources (dramatic backlighting or sidelight) should illuminate the character, highlighting the multilayered elements of the year through shadow.

Using the uploaded reference image, generate a four-panel composition (upper-left, upper-right, lower-left, lower-right).

Keep the person’s face, hairstyle, and clothing exactly the same as in the uploaded image for all panels.
Maintain a realistic photo style, consistent identity, and natural lighting.

Upper-left (Joy / Joy):
A close-up of her face from a slightly high angle. She is smiling brightly with sparkling eyes, expressing pure joy and happiness. Her expression feels open, warm, and genuinely delighted.

Upper-right (Anger / Anger):
A medium shot of her upper body. She is visibly angry, with furrowed brows and a sharp, intense expression. Her posture is tense, and she slightly clenches her fists or crosses her arms, clearly showing irritation or frustration.

Lower-left (Sadness / Sadness):
An over-the-shoulder or slightly downward-angled shot. Her body language is subdued and closed off. She looks down with a sorrowful, quiet expression, conveying loneliness or emotional pain, with a soft, muted mood.

Lower-right (Fun / Fun):
A casual selfie-style shot. She looks playful and energetic, laughing or making a cheerful, fun expression. The mood is lighthearted and carefree, showing her enjoying the moment.

- The hair shape should be drawn as a “white silhouette” integrated with the snowman's head. The ends of the hair should not be sharp but rounded and plump, like melting snow.

Generate a 9:16 vertical, realistic photo of 'Prosperous Tang Dynasty meets Paris': Use the uploaded FACE_REF as the character identity reference, 100% restoring the facial features and bone structure; the character is wearing a heavy-duty court gown in the style of a 'Tang Dynasty (High Tang) Imperial Concubine' (Qixiong Shanqun, large sleeves, peony patterns, gold ornaments), photographed at Trocadéro Square or the banks of the Seine beneath the Eiffel Tower in Paris. The image should have the photography, styling, and cover design quality of a COSMO fashion magazine, maintaining the magazine's consistent design style (English design).

【INPUTS | Input】 FACE_REF: The uploaded reference image for the character's facial features (Identity Lock)

【ABSOLUTE PRIORITY | Identity Lock (Highest Priority)】 100% restoration of FACE_REF's facial features and bone structure: Face shape, appearance, eye distance, nose bridge/alae, lip shape, jawline, and cheekbone structure must be completely consistent, without drifting. Realistic skin texture: Visible subtle textures and pores, avoid excessive smoothing or 'influencer' style. Adult female image.

【SHOT TYPE | Choose one of two shots (randomly selected by the model, must be truly consistent)】 A) Bust Cover: From the chest to above the waist, the headwear and upper body embroidery are clearest, eyes are sharpest focus (Primary recommendation) B) Full Body Cover: Complete presentation of the layered gown and skirt patterns from head to toe, stronger perspective of the Eiffel Tower's steel structure (Alternative) (Regardless of A/B: must maintain 'cover composition', with white space for layout, but no torn paper/hand-drawn effects.)

【LOCATION | Scene (Eiffel Tower, Paris)】 Eiffel Tower, Paris: Classic steel structure tower background. Choose one of two weather conditions (random): 1) Rainy Paris (ground slightly wet, soft light, high-end gray tone, strong fashion sense) 2) Brilliant Dusk (sunset glow, golden light and shadow, romantic atmosphere) Clean background: No tourists, no modern signs, no phone status bar UI, no watermarks/subtitles, no railings.

【LIGHTING & CAMERA | Photography Quality (Magazine Level)】 Lens feel: 85mm portrait quality (bust) or 50mm/70mm (full body), shallow depth of field, eyes in sharpest focus. Lighting: Natural light (emphasizing ambient light) + cinematic fill light; gold ornaments have realistic highlights but are not blown out; silk luster is clearly discernible. Color: High-end cinematic feel, French beige/blue-gray tones form a strong visual tension with the Tang Dynasty clothing's 'red, green, and gold' color scheme; overall clean, transparent, and rich in texture.

【WARDROBE | Tang Dynasty Court Gown (Plump, Flowing, Intense Colors)】 Target aesthetic: 'Ornate gold ornaments, facial makeup (mianye huadian), Qixiong skirt, flowing pibo (long scarf), intense red, green, and gold, extremely flamboyant.'

Silhouette and Layers (Must reflect Tang Dynasty characteristics) Inner layer: Hezi (bustier), exposing the neck and upper chest skin (reflecting the open atmosphere of the Tang Dynasty) Middle layer: Duijin short jacket (straight collar), transparent and light material (gauze/silk) Outer layer: Daxiu Shan (extremely wide sleeves, dragging on the floor), spread out like wings Decoration: Pibo (long silk ribbon), wrapped around the arms, fluttering in the wind Bottom wear: Qixiong Poqun (skirt waist tied at the chest, wide skirt hem, multi-color splicing or printing) Fabric and Craftsmanship (Heavy craftsmanship must be 'visible') Main fabrics: Silk, brocade, gold-printed gauze (combination of lightness and heaviness) Main techniques: Printing and dyeing (wax resist/clamping), gold thread embroidery, gold weaving Pattern themes (suitable for High Tang): Baoxiang flower, continuous peony vine, auspicious beasts (lion/kylin), Tuanhua (giant, full patterns) Details: Huadian (red decoration on the forehead), Mianye (red dots at the corners of the mouth), Armband (metal ornament on the upper arm) Headwear (Opulent Tang Dynasty headwear) Core structure: High bun (Yunji/Zhuaimaji), adorned with large peony flowers (real or silk) Decoration: Gold comb back (gold comb inserted into the bun), Buyao (swaying when moving), gold hairpin Earrings: Precious gold and jade

【COLOR MATRIX | Color Matrix Pairing (Must be executed, and must be 'Intense Tang Style')】 (Adjusted to Tang Dynasty popular colors: red-green contrast, brilliant gold) Randomly select 1 set from the following three 'Main Color Schemes' for the [Base Color/Large Area Main Fabric Color].

Scheme G (Stone Blue/Emerald Green Base): Base Color: {argument name="base color 1" default="Emerald Green/Stone Blue"} (common intermediate color) Embroidery/Printing: Madder Red, Gold, Orange Yellow, Off-White Scheme A (Peony Red Base): Base Color: {argument name="base color 2" default="Peony Red/Pomegranate Red"} (most classic Tang style) Embroidery/Printing: Gold, Emerald Green, Sapphire Blue, Purple Scheme R (Purple Base): Base Color: {argument name="base color 3" default="Purple/Grape Color"} (noble) Embroidery/Printing: Gold, Vermilion, Grass Green, Silver

【Color Execution Rules】 Color contrast must be strong, reflecting the grandeur of the High Tang, but the overall tone must be unified in a high-end feel.

【POSE | Cover Pose (Confident, Expansive, Queenly Feel)】 Bust: Head slightly raised, eyes looking down, one hand gently touching the bun or pibo Full Body: Arms spread out to drive the Daxiu Shan and Pibo, showcasing the volume of the clothing, full aura Expression: Confident, flamboyant, charming, generous; not shy.

【OUTPUT | Output】 1 vertical 9:16 realistic magazine cover-level photo Random: Bust or Full Body (A/B choice) Random: Rainy or Dusk (Weather choice) Random: Emerald Green / Peony Red / Purple (Color matrix choice) Styling: Tang Dynasty court gown direction + Peony flower/Gold comb headwear + Qixiong Daxiu + Pibo

In front of a marble-grey café exterior, decorated with a Christmas theme. Include a realistic Christmas tree, pine decorations, and festive ornaments.

Warm orange tungsten lighting for an inviting, cozy atmosphere, combined with a strong direct flash hitting the subject straight on, making her skin bright and glowing, contrasting with the slightly darker background.

On the table:

She holds a Christmas-decorated drink in her right hand and smiles slightly.

The flash creates extremely bright, slightly yellow-tinted skin with a hard shadow behind her.
High-contrast, ultra-sharp 8K image.
Warm ambient sunlight.
{argument name="film style" default="Fuji Film Pro 400H"} color style with old-lens filter and light film grain.
The subject should appear bright and stand out clearly from the background.

Floating Time Card: A frosted glass-textured 3D bubble floats directly above the Logo. The bubble encapsulates three-dimensional, softly glowing numbers (corresponding to usage duration, such as "{argument name="usage duration" default="4h 12m"}").

Buildings should not be arranged in isolation but should form neighborhoods. Tall buildings are in the center (CBD area), surrounded by potentially low-rise system application buildings (Settings, Calendar, etc.).

Traffic and Connection (The Data Flow):

Connection Method: Buildings must have physical connections.

Style Adaptation: If it's cyberpunk, use glowing fiber optic elevated bridges and maglev trains; if minimalist, use transparent glass pipes; if cute, use rainbow slides.

Battery Energy Station: A cylindrical energy tank (shaped like a battery icon) is located at the edge of the town, connected by thick cables to power the main building, where green liquid energy can even be seen sloshing.

Notification Airship: Small airships or clouds float in the air, hanging banners with “New Message” or “Red Dot.”

[4. Bottom Visual Center: Stylized 3D Nameplate] (Keep unchanged, emphasize high-end design sense)

Main Title Design: “SCREEN TIME” or “{argument name="main title" default="Today's Composition"}” are designed using Inflatable Typography or Neon Tube Fonts, with materials related to the current theme. They are not printed on paper but physically “stand” in the foreground of the image.

Subtitle Copy: Below the 3D title, generate a floating glowing light strip with a short, sharp comment based on user data.

content:
【Instruction Content】
Based on the user-inputted date, "The Day I Was Born ({argument name="birth date" default="1994/6/15"})," select 3 to 5 major news stories that were trending on or around that date, summarize the information including the culture and trends of that era, and generate a “general magazine cover image” laid out with that content as magazine headlines.

【Procedure (Your internal processing)】
1. Read the user's birth date and pick up multiple major news stories reported during that period.
2. Extract the design trends of that era (fonts, colors, paper quality, photo tone, layout).
3. Construct the magazine cover according to the design specifications below, and the final output should be only the image.

【Magazine Cover Design Specifications】
・Main Title: Must be "The Day I Was Born"
・Subtitle: A catchphrase that summarizes the year's character and historical background in one phrase
・The birth date (YYYY/MM/DD) must be placed on the cover
・Cover Composition:
　- The main visual is a photographic background symbolizing the era
　- Multiple extracted news stories are placed as magazine headlines
　- Trends of the time (music, movies, fashion, technology, etc.) are also made into auxiliary headlines
・Design Style:
　- Fonts, colors, photo graininess, and paper texture typical of a magazine from the birth year
　- Highly visible headline structure
・Text should be proofread into correct Japanese, and repeating the same sentence is prohibited
・Aspect Ratio: Vertical (Recommended 3:4)
・Quality: A realistic magazine cover with the texture of a printed material

A cozy-yet-alluring Christmas scene, reimagined. A stunning young woman with golden blonde, beachy waves is curled up in a large, plush armchair directly beside a crackling fireplace. She wears a short, festive dress—think a deep {argument name="dress color" default="emerald green or burgundy"} velvet with a delicate lace trim, featuring a slightly loose, off-shoulder neckline that reveals her collarbones and a hem that ends mid-thigh. Her bare legs are curled beneath her, one knee drawn up, showcasing her toned legs as a central focal point.

The room is a cozy Christmas haven: the mantle glows with candles and pine garlands, a beautifully lit tree twinkles softly in the background (rendered in creamy bokeh), and a half-finished mug of hot chocolate sits on a side table. The primary, mesmerizing light is the warm, flickering glow from the roaring fire, painting golden-orange highlights on her skin, the velvet of her dress, and the smooth curves of her legs.

Her pose is intimate and captivating. She leans slightly forward, resting her chin in her hand, her elbow propped on the chair's arm. Her expression is a soft, knowing smile directed at the camera, eyes sparkling with reflected firelight. One hand rests casually on her raised knee, drawing subtle attention to her legs. The pose is relaxed, natural, and effortlessly sensual.

Technical execution: Shot from a low angle (slightly below her eye level) and close-medium distance to emphasize the length of her legs and the cozy setting. An 85mm f/1.8 lens compresses the scene beautifully, creating a shallow depth of field that melts the Christmas lights into soft, glowing spheres while keeping her face, décolletage, and legs tack-sharp. Aperture is wide open (f/1.8). A shutter speed of 1/60s captures the dynamic flicker of the flames. ISO 2500 adds a fine, cinematic grain. Color grading is rich and festive: deep emeralds/reds, warm amber firelight, and cool shadows. The aesthetic is hyper-realistic, intimate, and beautifully festive—a private holiday moment of warm allure.

content:
Golden hour-turned-noir car selfie. A young woman with sun-streaked blonde hair—textured, layered, with effortless bedhead volume—casts a seductive, knowing look over the rim of her 90s rectangle rimless sunglasses (brown gradient lenses, gold bridge). Her skin is porcelain-white with a hyper-glowy, glass-skin finish; intense specular highlights blaze on her cheekbones and the tip of her nose. Her hazel-green eyes squint slightly. Plump, glossy nude-pink lips are slightly parted, with the subtle, playful press of her tongue against the teeth.

She wears a high-reflectivity champagne-silver sequin tube top, each sequin catching the light as a distinct point of glitter. Her right hand, adorned with stacked chunky gold dome rings on multiple fingers, adjusts the sunglasses frame on her nose. Her left hand is splayed against her chest, showcasing Cartier-style gold love bangles on her wrist.

The scene is inside a luxury car's dark leather interior at night. Through the rear window, out-of-focus city lights melt into a creamy, dark bokeh. The mood is intimate and moody, shattered by the stark, high-contrast blast of a hard, direct on-camera flash. The flash freezes every detail: the texture in her hair, the sparkle of sequins, the gleam of jewelry, and the dewy skin, creating deep, inky shadows.

Shot with a feel akin to a Canon G7X Mark II or iPhone 15 Pro Night Mode with flash—using a wide 24mm lens for a slight, intimate distortion. Aperture at f/2.8 for sharp focus on the face and jewelry against the blurred lights. Color grading is warm and cinematic: saturated golden skin tones, rich blacks, and a touch of filmic grain. The aesthetic is hyper-realistic, sharp, and effortlessly cool—a candid moment loaded with glamour.

content:
Subject & Wardrobe: A striking Asian female with a razor-sharp jet-black pixie cut (textured with pomade, asymmetrical fringe grazing her right brow), sporting matte-black oversized cat-eye sunglasses (acetate frames with micro-scratches). Her fingers are adorned with 5 silver rings: a skull signet, a serpent coil, a geometric cube, a band with etched runes, and a cracked obsidian stone. She wears a crimson vinyl bomber jacket (high-gloss, ribbed cuffs), collar popped, catching the backlight like liquid fire. Beneath, a sleeveless mesh top reveals a dragon tattoo creeping up her forearm. 

Camera & Perspective: Extreme worm's-eye view shot from inside a drainage pipe (circular, 18-inch diameter), lens positioned 6 inches above the wet ground. Forced perspective distortion makes her hand a monumental, terrifying presence—fingers elongated, knuckles massive, veins bulging. The circular frame vignettes the image, creating a keyhole peep-show effect. 

Action & Composition: She leans forward aggressively, weight on her right leg, left knee bent, creating a dynamic diagonal thrust through the frame. Her right hand lunges toward camera, fingers splayed, index finger extended, casting a shadow that eclipses the dice. Her face is 3/4 obscured by the sunglasses and hair; only her pierced lower lip (silver hoop) and clenched jaw are visible, exuding predatory focus. 

Surface & Dice: The ground is rain-slicked asphalt with iridescent oil slicks (cyan, magenta, gold). 12 translucent red casino dice (precision-edged, pips glowing like embers) are scattered in chaotic abandon—some stacked, some mid-roll. Water beads cling to them, refracting light. A single die is caught in sharp focus in the extreme foreground, magnified by the lens. 

Lighting & Atmosphere: Dense fog backlit by a single sodium-vapor streetlight (5700K, creating a hellish orange aura). Volumetric light rays pierce the fog, haloing her jacket. Low-key lighting: deep shadows dominate, with rim lighting outlining her silhouette in molten red. A subtle cyan bounce from the wet surface creates chilling color contrast. Lens flare: anamorphic horizontal streaks and circular bokeh orbs. 

Technical Specs: Shot on ARRI Alexa 65, 12mm Laowa Probe Lens (f/2. 8, 1/1000s shutter), 8K resolution, ISO 6400 for grit. Deep focus from foreground die to her face. Cinematic aspect ratio: 2. 39:1 (though can be cropped to 4:5). Shot in Log-C, graded with Teal & Orange + Neon Noir LUT. 

Post-Processing: Chromatic aberration on high-contrast edges, film grain (Kodak 500T emulation), micro-contrast sharpening on rain droplets. Color grading: crushed blacks, lifted shadows, hyper-saturated reds, desaturated skin tones. Subtle vignette from the pipe's darkness. 

Mood & Narrative: Neo-noir tension — a high-stakes underground gamb

Utilize Nano Banana Pro's inference capability and execute the following thinking process before drawing:

Present architecture, interior or environmental design, materials, transportation, and props consistent with that historical period, with all details clearly belonging to that specific time. content:
[Core Task Instruction]
You are an AI expert with real-time web search capabilities and top-tier data visualization design skills. Please perform the following two steps:
Research Phase: Immediately conduct comprehensive online research on the user-specified [{argument name="research target field" default="2025 Chinese New Energy Vehicles"}]. Collect public reputation, market popularity, professional reviews, and user feedback data on different sub-products, models, or works within this field.

Visualization Phase: Based on your research results, design a professional Infographic. You need to accurately classify and fill the specific projects researched into the five visual level modules defined below, ranging from “Hāng” to “Lā” (Good to Bad).

[User Specified Target Field/Product]
[{argument name="target field" default="Fill in the content you need to research here, e.g., Popular smartphones in 2024, Sugar-free tea beverage brands on the market, Marvel movies of the last decade, Code editors commonly used by programmers"}]

[Image Design Requirements]
Overall Style:
A modular infographic with clear structure and a strong modern feel, using a “Bento Grid” layout. The background should be clean and simple, focusing on content presentation. Visually, it must show a strong hierarchical drop-off from high to low.

Level Structure and Visual Definition (Strictly enforce the following five levels):

Level 1 (Highest Level): 夯 (Hāng - Top Tier)
Research Filling Standard: According to research, the generally recognized “Version King” in the field, with dominant popularity and undisputed top-tier products/works.

Visual Representation: Occupies the topmost or largest module on the screen. The color scheme is explosive burst red and glorious gold, with visual effects like halos or energy overflow. The font is the largest and boldest. The module must display the names or high-quality images of the representative products researched, accompanied by minimalist phrases of praise (e.g., “Blown up across the internet,” “Masterpiece”).

Level 2: Top Tier

Research Filling Standard: Hardcore powerhouses, whose reputation may not be as high as “Hāng,” but are highly praised and are the preferred high-quality projects for experts.

Visual Representation: Located on the second layer. The color scheme is solid, high-end burning orange and metallic silver. The module design appears robust and textured. Display representative powerhouse products.

Level 3: Superior

Research Filling Standard: Superior choices, tasteful, solid middle ground that is definitely worth buying/watching, representing a certain level of connoisseurship.

Visual Representation: Located in the middle layer. The color scheme is bright, clean lemon yellow and cool gray. The design style is modern and refreshing. Display representative high-quality middle-class products.

Level 4: NPC

Research Filling Standard: Generic products with no memory points, mass-produced industrial products, neither good nor bad, easily forgotten. Must include specific product or brand names, do not be vague.

Visual Representation: Located in the lower-middle layer. The color scheme is dull and bland bread color/beige or cardboard brown. The module design appears ordinary, repetitive, and lacks personality. Display those very mediocre products.

Level 5 (Bottom Level): 拉完了 (Lā - Failed)

Research Filling Standard: Recognized “landmines,” “IQ taxes,” disastrous failed products found in the research, or even products that are worse than nothing. Must include specific product or brand names, do not be vague.

Visual Representation: Squeezed into the bottom or corner of the screen, with compressed visual space. The color scheme is desperate black, pale white, and features obvious digital glitch, fragmentation, or decay visual effects. Display those famous “flop” products, accompanied by warning phrases (e.g., “Run away,” “Big sucker”).

You are a **photo essayist and graphic designer who records lifestyle**. Based on the input text (and attached image) provided at the end, please generate a **“multi-cut scrapbook-style image that captures the memory of a fun meal.”**

At that time, please include the character from the attached reference image, positioned as **“stickers or cut-out photos that accent the album,”** and assign them a **role (such as posing as if saying 'Itadakimasu' or commenting in a corner)**.

▼ Instructions for the Generation Process (Thinking Process)
Utilize Nano Banana Pro's reasoning ability and execute the following thought process before drawing:

1.  **[Step 1: Scene Expansion and Diversification]**: Imagine (simulate) multiple cuts that convey a story from the single input image of the “pot of food.”
    * Cut A (Main): The finished dish served in a stylish bowl.
    * Cut B (Sub): A close-up of fresh ingredients (e.g., the freshness of vegetables).
    * Cut C (Sub): A close-up shot showing steam/sizzle, or the moment a spoon scoops the food.
2.  **[Step 2: Album Composition Design]**: Set the background to a “wooden table” or “kraft paper,” and arrange the 3-4 photos above randomly and balanced in a Polaroid or bordered photo style.
3.  **[Step 3: Decoration and Handwritten Text]**: Place masking tape, clips, and handwritten-style Japanese comments (“Great!”, “Delicious,” etc.) and a date around the photos to complete a DIY-style album.

▼ Design and Style Specification
* **Composition/Layout**: **Collage/Multi-panel format**. A busy composition viewed from directly above (flat lay), with multiple photos overlapping.
* **Aesthetic**: Warm, “film camera” texture. A nostalgic tone with slightly desaturated colors.
* **Text**:
    * Draw the dish name and **date (e.g., {argument name="Date" default="2025.12.07"})** in a **handwritten-style font** in the margin or label area below the photo.
    * Decorative text like “Yummy!” or “Recipe Memo” next to the photos.
* **Character**: Process the reference character into a “sticker style” or “photo cut-out style” and depict them as if they are pasted onto the album page.

▼ Input Text
(Enter a brief description of the “contents of the pot” here. Example: “Seafood hot pot I ate with friends,” “Tomato stew I made on the weekend,” etc.)
{argument name="Dish" default="Chicken Paitan Hot Pot"}

content:
Ultra-Wide Angle Perspective and Dynamic Pose Remake Edit
This is an edit of the original image, not the generation of a new character.
Please use the original image as a strict reference to determine:
 * The identity, hairstyle, and overall fashion style of the person,
 * The general type of background and location (same street, same room, same beach, same architectural style, etc.).
It is allowed to completely change the camera position, angle, and pose, but the scene must remain in the same location, and the same person and clothing design must be retained.
Camera and Perspective:
 * Use an ultra-wide-angle or fisheye lens feel (approx. 12–18mm full-frame look).
 * The camera angle must be significantly different from the original image: use dramatic angles, such as:
   * Low angle looking up from directly below (worm's eye view),
   * High angle looking down from directly above (bird's eye view),
   * Extremely low angle close to the ground,
   * High angle shot from above,
   * Tilted Dutch angles.
 * Always create a strong **foreshortening** effect: body parts close to the lens appear huge, while the rest of the body recedes in perspective.
 * The final result must look like a bold fashion or street photograph, completely realistic, not an illustration or anime.
Background Consistency:
 * Maintain the same location as the original image: the same street, bridge, room, studio, beach, and the same general structure and materials.
 * Do not replace the background with a completely different place.
 * Seeing different parts of the environment is allowed and expected due to the change in camera angle.
 * When new areas appear, logically extend the original environment (same architecture, fences, road signs, walls, colors, materials, lighting style), as if the camera moved within the same place.
Body Parts Close to the Lens (1–2 parts, sometimes 3):
 * In each edit, select one or two main body parts extremely close to the lens (sometimes even three in more complex poses).
 * Vary between different images; do not always use the same body parts.
 * Allowed body parts close to the lens include:
   * One or both hands/fingers reaching towards the camera,
   * One or both feet/shoes/boots close to the lens,
   * Knees or thighs,
   * Face very close to the lens,
   * Shoulders or chest close to the lens in a tilted pose.
 * The selected body parts should be extremely close to the lens, almost touching it, and exhibit visible skin texture, fabric texture, and realistic wide-angle distortion.
Pose and Overall Posture (Complex and Varied):
 * Create strong, cool, dynamic poses to match the extreme perspective.
 * Randomly use different types of poses, including:
   * Standing and extending one leg or one hand towards the camera,
   * Crouching or squatting low to the ground,
   * Sitting on the floor or an object,
   * Lying on the ground with legs or feet towards the lens,
   * Leaning aggressively towards the camera,
   * Twisting the body, crossing legs, or arching the back to form more dynamic lines.
 * Complex poses are allowed, such as:
   * Hands forming shapes near the lens (peace sign, triangle, frame, pointing at the viewer),
   * Both feet towards the lens,
   * One hand and one foot both enlarged in the foreground,
   * Face close to the lens while hands or feet are also visible in perspective.
 * Maintain credible anatomy even with extreme foreshortening.
Angle and Attitude (Randomization):
 * Randomize camera angle and direction (up, down, side, Dutch tilt) while keeping the composition visually balanced and powerful.
 * Maintain a cool, confident, and fashion/editorial or street style atmosphere, depending on the original outfit.
 * Facial expressions can vary (serious, playful, confident, mysterious) but must still look like the same person.
Lighting and Rendering:
 * Maintain a similar general time period and lighting atmosphere as the original (day vs. night, indoor vs. outdoor, soft light vs. hard light), but enhance contrast and color to make the image powerful and dramatic.
 * Maintain realistic shadows and contact points with the ground or floor.
 * High resolution, sharp details, with clear skin texture, fabric weave, and material highlights.
Variation and Randomness:
 * Each edit should look distinctly different from the original and other edits, with different:
   * Camera angles,
   * Pose types,
   * Body parts closest to the lens,
   * Orientation (straight, tilted, from above, from below).
 * Avoid repeating the exact same “single foot close-up” composition; generate a variety of dynamic poses and angles.
Strict Rules:
 * Do not turn the person into someone else.
 * Do not change the type of clothing; only restyle it through pose, perspective, and minor natural movement of the garment.
 * Do not move the scene to a completely different location; always stay within a logical extension of the original location.
 * Do not add text, logos, watermarks, or graphic design elements.
 * Do not switch to painting, illustration, or anime style; maintain realism.
Summary:
Transform the original photo into a dramatic, realistic, ultra-wide-angle photograph with extreme camera angles (including viewing from directly below or above), where one or more body parts are tight against the lens and appear huge, the rest of the body recedes in perspective, and the same person poses in a fashionable, complex, and powerful manner within a consistent, extended version of the original environment.

content:
You are a world-class travel influencer and art director. Analyze the input text (latitude and longitude) provided at the end, and generate an overwhelmingly stunning travel photo capable of earning "100,000 likes" on Instagram or TikTok.

The character from the attached reference image will appear as the admired traveler.

▼ Instructions for Generation Process (Thinking Process)
Utilize Nano Banana Pro's reasoning capabilities to solve the following "Aesthetic Appeal" equation before drawing:

1. [Step 1: Identifying Aesthetically Pleasing Locations and Angles]:
   - Identify the location from the input coordinates and select the most popular "photo spots" and "iconic compositions" on social media.
   - Calculate angles (such as dynamic compositions with ultra-wide angle or drone views) that emphasize scale or create narrative by including a person, rather than just a landscape photo.

2. [Step 2: Fashion Styling Aiming for Complementary Colors]:
   - Analyze the main color of the background (e.g., green for a forest, brown for a desert, blue for the sea) and select fashionable clothing in its "complementary color" (opposite color) or high-contrast colors.
   - The clothing should be suitable for the "local climate" while emphasizing trendiness, such as high fashion, bohemian style, or luxury streetwear.
   - Include items (sunglasses, hats, vintage cameras, local drinks, etc.) to create a natural, effortless look.

3. [Step 3: Emotional Light and Color Direction]:
   - Set the time of day to "Golden Hour (golden light just before sunset)" or "Blue Hour (blue light before dawn)" to create dramatic shadows.
   - Simulate color grading (color correction) to apply filters favored on social media, such as "Teal & Orange" or "Pastel Dream."

▼ Design and Style Specification
* Composition/Layout: Beautifully blur the background with shallow depth of field (Bokeh), or use a wide-angle lens (16mm) to make limbs look longer while capturing the magnificent scenery. Be mindful of the Rule of Thirds.
* Taste: A dreamy yet vivid visual creation that evokes "Wanderlust" (a craving for travel). 8k resolution, Unsplash style photography.
* Character: Maintain the facial features of the reference image while adopting attractive poses that draw in the viewer, such as an pensive look directly at the camera or a smile while turning back. Add movement by showing hair blowing in the wind.
* Text: Stylishly place the name of the location subtly but accurately spelled on signs or items within the image (if possible).

▼ Input Text
Latitude and Longitude: {argument name="latitude and longitude" default="36.4618° N, 25.3753° E"}

Generate a beautiful background illustration in the style of Makoto Shinkai’s animated films. The core scene is: "{argument name="scene" default="a railway crossing in full bloom with cherry blossoms"}", but the focus is not on characters; it is on the environment and the atmosphere of the sky.

Use a wide 16:9 composition, as if it were a single frame taken directly from a Shinkai movie. The sky must be the absolute protagonist, occupying most of the frame. Paint an extremely spectacular, detail-rich sky: for example, a towering cumulonimbus cloud stretching to the heavens, or gorgeous evening clouds where orange, purple, and deep blue gradients interweave, or a huge rainbow arching over the city after the rain. The lighting should be at the most magical time of day, either Golden Hour or Blue Hour. Include strong yet soft lens flares in the sky, with sunlight streaming through gaps in the clouds to form clear volumetric rays, and tiny glowing dust motes and light particles drifting in the air.

For the ground and environment, render the {scene} in near photo-realistic detail: carefully depict utility poles, complex webs of power lines, road signs, traffic lights, vending machines, distant skyscraper silhouettes, and the small traces of everyday urban life. If the scene includes rain or puddles, the ground should look wet, reflecting the colors of the sky and nearby lights like a mirror, filling the image with a transparent, cool atmosphere and a sense of slight humidity.

In terms of composition, use a wide-angle, large-scale view to emphasize the grandeur of the environment and a strong sense of depth, making the viewer feel like they are looking up and being swallowed by the scenery. If there are characters in the image, they should be tiny silhouettes or back views, standing at a street corner, on a rooftop, or by the railway, gazing at the sky or the distance. Their small figures should enhance the sense of story, loneliness, and imagined future, without stealing the spotlight from the environment.

The overall color should be clear and saturated but not harsh. The contrast between light and shadow should be strong yet still soft, with enough detail that the image can be used directly as a desktop wallpaper. The style must clearly carry Shinkai’s signature sense of romance and transparency, rather than a heavy oil painting or pure photographic realism. High-resolution illustration, 16:9 widescreen ratio.

content:
Generate an art photograph of a highly dreamy and three-dimensional 3D paper cut light box.  
The paper cut theme is: {argument name="theme" default="a deer in a forest under the moonlight"}.

Layering structure and composition:
Design the image as a real, physical paper cut light box composed of 5–7 layers of paper stacked together. Each layer must have its own depth of field and clear silhouette, and you should be able to see the thickness of the paper and the shadows between layers.

Core structure:
- The image should clearly present a multi-layered silhouette effect, with visible physical spacing between the paper layers.
- Overall composition is vertical 3:4, with the light box centered, leaving a bit of space at the edges, like a glowing art object placed on a table.

Depth layout:
- Foreground (layers 1–2): use dark, intricate silhouettes that form a frame around the edges of the image, with elements matching the current theme, such as branches and vines for forest themes, windows and arches for city or castle themes, or rocks and coral for underwater or fantasy themes.
- Midground (layers 3–4): this holds the core subject of the theme, slightly central in the composition and taking up the main visual weight. The subject’s silhouette must be complete and not overly blocked by the foreground.
- Background (layers 5–6): use more simplified, lower-contrast silhouettes to show distant environment and structures, adding depth to the scene.

Three-dimensionality:
- There must be obvious physical spacing and shadows between layers. Light should pass between the paper layers to create soft gradations of light and dark, emphasizing the paper thickness and 3D depth, so it looks like a real paper cut light box, not a flat illustration.

Light and atmosphere (backlighting):
Backlighting:
- The light source must come from the very back of the scene, shining forward through all the paper layers.
- Light passing through the cutouts in each layer should form soft volumetric light and gradually decreasing brightness and contrast from back to front.

Color gradients (auto-adapting to the theme):
If no specific color scheme is given, automatically choose a main palette and gradient that fit the theme, while keeping a soft, night-light-friendly look. For example, warm gold to cool blue-green for forest themes, teal to deep blue for underwater themes, icy blue to deep blue for winter scenes, amber to electric blue for cyber cities, candlelight gold to deep indigo for castles, or deep blue to purple with golden glows for space themes.
If the user clearly specifies a color direction or mood (such as “cool sci-fi” or “pink-blue dreamy”), follow that as the top priority while maintaining the soft backlit, soothing feeling of a night light.

Overall feel:
The image should feel quiet, healing, and storybook-like, like a softly glowing bedtime story lamp, not a noisy neon poster or infographic.

Materials and details:
Paper texture:
- Emphasize the reality of heavy art paper: fine texture, slight visible fibers, clean sharp cut edges with visible thickness, and light that diffuses softly through the paper like a real fibrous material, not plastic or metal.

Physical light box photography feel:
- Present the image as a photograph of a real light box, not a flat illustration or vector graphic. You can faintly show the light box frame (simple white or light wood) and a slightly blurred tabletop or environment.
- The lighting should feel natural, with real-lens depth of field: slightly blurred foreground, sharp midground subject, and soft background.

Detail decorations:
- You may add a modest amount of tiny floating elements between paper layers to enhance space, such as tiny glowing dots, dust motes, snowflakes, bubbles, or other small particles relevant to the theme. Their number must be restrained so they only enhance atmosphere and depth without cluttering or disrupting the silhouette structure.

Technical parameters: vertical 3:4 ratio, high-resolution output.
title: 3D paper cut light box illustration framework
description: A detailed prompt template for generating dreamy, multi-layered 3D paper cut light box artworks, where you can swap in any theme and the model handles layers, lighting, color logic, and material realism.

content:
[Purpose]
Create a "meme-style illustration where clothes get cut away based on ♥ and 🔄 counts" by referring to a user-uploaded character image, inheriting only the design elements while redrawing the facial expression and pose.

[Handling of the reference]
- Refer only to hairstyle, colors, outfit, and overall vibe
- The facial expression and pose must always be newly redrawn
- Do not make a complete copy of the reference image

[Composition]
- Framing from bust-up to waist, mostly facing front
- Place the character on the left side
- Background is simple white
- In front of the character, place **five short horizontal dotted lines** (they should not extend across the entire canvas, only slightly longer than the character’s width)
- The five horizontal lines divide at the shoulders, chest, abdomen, waist, and crotch. Always draw all five horizontal lines
- Place a ✂ icon to the left of the top horizontal dotted line
- On the right side of each horizontal line, place ♥ / 🔄 plus numbers, aligned exactly to the vertical center of each dotted line
- Add a small "diagram showing how the outfit is being cut" in the upper-right corner (do not include text)

[Right side labels (from top to bottom)]
1. ♥5,000 (bright red)
2. 🔄1,000 (bright yellow-green)
3. ♥1,000 (bright red)
4. 🔄250 (bright yellow-green)
5. ♥100 (bright red)
- 🔄 should look like the repost icon on X
- All fonts should be cute, handwritten style

[Character depiction]
- Include external features that clearly show it is the referenced character (hair, eyes, colors, outfit, etc.)
- Blushing expression that mixes embarrassment and being upset
- A shy pose that tries to hide the body
- Keep the outfit based on the reference without changing it; do not cut or remove clothes

[Illustration style]
- Pop, cute 2D anime style
- Soft, loose line art with bright colors
- Prioritize readability as a meme image
- No unnecessary decorations, keep the layout clean and simple

You are specialized in computational photography, specifically the optical characteristics of the {argument name="phone model" default="iPhone 16/17 Pro Max"} sensor system. You translate human concepts into mathematically precise image generation prompts.

<cognitive_framework>
<principle name="Context Hunger">
If the user provides a vague concept (for example, "{argument name="example vague concept" default="girl at a cafe"}"), you must explicitly invent the missing environmental, lighting, and styling details to ensure a complete image.
</principle>
<principle name="The iPhone Aesthetic">
All outputs must strictly simulate high-end mobile photography.
- Focal Lengths: {argument name="main focal length" default="24mm"} (Main), {argument name="ultra wide focal length" default="13mm"} (Ultra Wide), or {argument name="telephoto focal length" default="77mm"} (Telephoto).
- Characteristics: "Apple ProRAW" color science, sharp details (Deep Fusion), computational bokeh (Portrait Mode), and Smart HDR dynamic range.
- Avoid: anamorphic lens flares, exaggerated "cinema" bokeh, or vintage film grain (unless specified as a filter).
</principle>
<principle name="Imperfection is Realism">
To achieve "ultra-realism," you must inject terms describing unpolished reality: digital noise (not film grain), skin texture, slightly blown-out highlights (common in mobile), and natural "snapshot" framing.
</principle>
<principle name="JSON Precision">
Your output is a strict JSON object designed for programmatic use.
</principle>
</cognitive_framework>

<visual_analysis_reference>
The "Influencer Aesthetic" is defined by:
- Vibe: "Plandid" (planned candid), effortlessness, aspirational lifestyle.
- Lighting: natural window light, golden hour, or "flash photography" (hard flash) for night shots.

1. Analyze the user's request for subject and mood.

{

  "negative_prompt": "Standard negatives + 'professional camera, DSLR, bokeh balls, anamorphic, cinema lighting, studio lighting'"

Await the user's description of the scene. Generate the JSON output immediately.

Aperture wide open (f/1.8-2.8) to create a glowing contour with shallow depth of field.

content:
Transform the user-uploaded image (photo or illustration) into a dramatic Japanese-inspired anime artwork. Always extract and use only the subject (the person) from the source image, and completely ignore or remove the original background. If the source is an illustration, repaint it in a refined anime style with beautiful Japanese-inspired three-dimensional shading, adding depth, gradients, and luminous highlights for a polished finish. If the source is a photo, reinterpret it as a realistic anime illustration, preserving natural skin, hair, and material textures, but applying painterly anime shading with strong depth. In all cases, redraw the subject in a powerful, dynamic, and energetic pose with a vivid and lively expression.

Foreground calligraphy: Add large Japanese brush-style calligraphy at the very front, layered above both the character and the background. Use exactly the Japanese characters provided by the user (kanji, katakana, or hiragana). Render the characters faithfully, without altering, breaking, or stylizing them incorrectly. Do not translate or replace them. The calligraphy should be bold black ink with a glowing, blurred white outline, surrounded by sumi ink splashes and scattered brush marks to convey motion and impact. The text content will be “{argument name="foreground_text1_en" default="Flame Hashira"}” and “{argument name="foreground_text2_en" default="Kyojuro Rengoku"}”.

Attribute effect: Add the specified attribute effect ({argument name="attribute_en" default="fire"}) flowing dynamically with the character’s movement, drawn in a modern Ukiyo-e-inspired anime style with dramatic shapes, glowing highlights, particles, and energy trails.

Background: Do not include the original photo background under any circumstances. Instead, fill the entire background with stylized Japanese patterns (Seigaiha waves, Asanoha hemp leaf, Kikkō tortoise shell, stylized clouds, etc.) combined with glowing elemental effects. Use deep navy, gold, and contrasting tones to create a luxurious Japanese atmosphere. Keep the background dark and patterned so the character, calligraphy, and attribute effects remain the primary focus.

Overall: Always preserve the subject’s essential traits (hairstyle, outfit, facial features, body type) while enhancing impact, movement, and Japanese aesthetics through dynamic shading, expressive brush calligraphy, dramatic attribute effects, and traditional motifs.
title: Kimetsu no Yaiba-style anime transformation with brush calligraphy
description: A comprehensive English prompt that transforms an uploaded image into a dramatic Japanese anime illustration with bold brush calligraphy, fire effects, and a traditional patterned background, preserving the original subject.
